title.en: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
title.zh: 英国首相伯纳姆誓言支持乌克兰，尽管俄罗斯发出“无耻的威胁”

summary.en: It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Andy Burnham has promised to keep up the pressure on Russia despite Moscow's "outrageous threats", on his first official visit to Ukraine as UK prime minister.

Burnham met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and chaired his first meeting of the "coalition of the willing", set up by the UK and France under his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer.

He said the coalition was "doing everything we can" while urging the US Congress to "ratchet up" economic pressure on Russia.

The government has agreed to hand over blueprints for British-made components for the Scalp missile, a French version of the UK's Storm Shadow cruise missile - allowing Ukraine to produce the long-range weapon domestically.

Burnham said allies were doing "everything we can" to "dig into our own stocks and help others dig into their stocks" of air defences to protect Ukraine.

"This is the moment to keep up the pressure on Russia, the moment to squeeze their ability to fund this illegal war," Burnham said, praising the "strength" of the Ukrainian people.

"Ukraine has been Europe's protector, not a drain on our security but the front line in keeping Europe safe."

It comes after Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov criticised the UK's decision to share the missile blueprints. Peskov said it prevented "even the slightest progress" towards achieving peace.

He told reporters on Monday that the Russian military was already gathering data to locate any missile production sites to destroy them.

"Britain is involved in this war on the side of the Kyiv regime. Britain methodically and regularly adds fuel to the fire," he added.

In response, Burnham said: "Who started the fire? That's the question, isn't it?"

He said the issue of missile interceptors would be the main topic at the coalition of the willing meeting.

Burnham has been reaffirming the UK's backing for Kyiv in the wake of escalating Russian strikes on Ukraine in recent weeks - including one on a shopping centre on Friday that killed at least 16 people.

In a joint statement after the meeting, Burnham and co-chairs French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the group would aim to strength Kyiv's air defences "as a matter or urgenty priority".

They also condemned Moscow's "systemic and escalating strikes against Ukraine's cities, critical infrastructure and civilians" and pledged to "constrain Russia's war chest through sanctions and actions against the "shadow fleet".

It came as the European Union said it had released €6.1bn (£5.2bn) in military aid for Ukraine to boost its air defences. The finance is part of a wider €90bn loan from the EU to Ukraine.

The UK and Ukraine have also announced a new military technology partnership giving British experts access to Kyiv's Avengers AI Labs...
body.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆在作为英国首相首次正式访问乌克兰时承诺，尽管莫斯科发出“无耻的威胁”，但仍将继续向俄罗斯施压。 伯纳姆会见了乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基，并主持了他的第一次“自愿联盟”会议，该联盟是由英国和法国在其前任凯尔·斯塔默爵士领导下成立的。 他表示，该联盟正在“尽我们所能”，同时敦促美国国会“加大”对俄罗斯的经济压力。 政府已同意移交英国制造的“头皮”导弹零部件的设计图，该导弹是英国“风暴之影”巡航导弹的法国版本，从而使乌克兰能够在国内生产这种远程武器。 伯纳姆表示，盟国正在尽一切努力“挖掘我们自己的库存并帮助其他国家挖掘他们的”防空系统来保护乌克兰。 伯纳姆说：“现在是继续向俄罗斯施压的时刻，是挤压他们为这场非法战争提供资金的能力的时刻。”他赞扬了乌克兰人民的“力量”。 “乌克兰一直是欧洲的保护者，不是我们安全的消耗者，而是维护欧洲安全的前线。” 此前，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫批评了英国分享导弹蓝图的决定。佩斯科夫表示，这阻碍了实现和平的“哪怕是最轻微的进展”。 他周一告诉记者，俄罗斯军方已经在收集数据，以确定任何导弹生产基地的位置，以摧毁它们。 “英国站在基辅政权一边卷入这场战争。英国有条不紊、定期火上浇油，”他补充道。 伯纳姆回应道：“谁放火了？这就是问题所在，不是吗？” 他表示，导弹拦截器问题将是联盟自愿会议的主要议题。 最近几周，俄罗斯对乌克兰的袭击不断升级，其中周五针对一家购物中心的袭击造成至少 16 人死亡，伯纳姆一直重申英国对基辅的支持。 在会后的一份联合声明中，伯纳姆和联合主席法国总统马克龙和德国总理梅尔茨表示，该组织的目标是“作​​为一项事项或紧急优先事项”加强基辅的防空。 他们还谴责莫斯科“对乌克兰城市、关键基础设施和平民进行系统性和不断升级的袭击”，并承诺“通过制裁和针对‘影子舰队’的行动来限制俄罗斯的战争资金。” 与此同时，欧盟表示已向乌克兰提供 61 亿欧元（52 亿英镑）军事援助，以增强其防空能力。该资金是欧盟向乌克兰提供的 900 亿欧元贷款的一部分。 英国和乌克兰还宣布建立新的军事技术合作伙伴关系，让英国专家能够进入基辅的复仇者联盟人工智能实验室……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to hope, endurance, and faithful rebuilding. Romans 12:12 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steady hope and perseverance, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到盼望、忍耐与重建。Romans 12:12提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以坚定盼望与忍耐来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

summary.en: Cost of living has hit campaign group while multinationals are threatening to squeeze out independent breweries For centuries, the wooden real ale pump has been the hallmark of a good British boozer. But now problems are brewing for the proper pint, as the Campaign for Real Ale...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Cost of living has hit campaign group while multinationals are threatening to squeeze out independent breweries For centuries, the wooden real ale pump has been the hallmark of a good British boozer. But now problems are brewing for the proper pint, as the Campaign for Real Ale has seen its membership sink to an eight-year low and its accounts show it is firmly in the red, making an £800,000 loss last year. Real ale is a traditional draught cask beer, a “living” product that is produced and stored in its cask. It differs from a cold, fizzy lager, in which the yeast is killed and carbon dioxide is added. Real ale contains live yeast so it continues fermenting until it is served. Continue reading...
body.zh: 生活成本打击了竞选团队，而跨国公司则威胁要排挤独立啤酒厂。几个世纪以来，木制纯麦芽啤酒泵一直是英国优质酒商的标志。但现在，正品脱啤酒的问题正在酝酿之中，因为“真正啤酒运动”的会员数量已降至八年来的最低点，而且其账目显示该组织正处于亏损状态，去年亏损了 80 万英镑。真啤酒是一种传统的桶装生啤酒，是在木桶中生产和储存的“活”产品。它与冷的起泡啤酒不同，后者杀死了酵母并添加了二氧化碳。真啤酒含有活酵母，因此它会持续发酵直至饮用。继续阅读...

title.en: Burnham says UK with Ukraine ‘all the way’ despite ‘outrageous threats’ from Russia – Europe live
title.zh: 伯纳姆表示，尽管俄罗斯发出“无耻威胁”，英国仍将“一路”与乌克兰同在——欧洲直播

summary.en: The UK's Andy Burnham affirmed unwavering support for Ukraine, stating that international borders cannot be changed by force and pledging continued assistance to the Ukrainian people from Lviv to Luhansk. This comes as the Coalition of the Willing condemns Russian strikes and commits to constraining Russia's war chest.
summary.zh: 英国的安迪·伯纳姆重申对乌克兰坚定不移的支持，表示国际边界不能通过武力改变，并承诺将继续援助从利沃夫到卢甘斯克的乌克兰人民。此前，“意愿联盟”谴责俄罗斯对乌克兰的袭击，并承诺限制俄罗斯的战争资金。

body.en:
British prime minister Andy Burnham said that the UK will help Ukraine make its own long-range missiles by sharing classified technical information for British components. Burnham, who was in Kyiv alongside other international leaders for Ukraine’s Independence Day, said defence firm MBDA will release details on UK-made parts for the SCALP missile to Ukraine to help the country assemble the weapons.

Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said ⁠there ⁠will be ​a “diplomatic track” with Russia discussing ⁠Moscow’s stepped-up attacks in the ⁠Black Sea ​that have ‌curbed ‌Ukraine’s export capabilities. Ukraine ‌will also strengthen its air defences in the region, he told ‌reporters.

Zelenskyy urged Ukraine’s allies to ⁠deliver an ⁠air ​defence package ahead of ⁠the winter, with Russia expected to renew ⁠its strikes on ​his country’s ‌energy ‌infrastructure, Reuters reported. Addressing a Coalition ‌of the Willing meeting in Kyiv, Zelenskyy also asked Ukraine’s partners to help ‌cover a funding gap of 27 ​billion euros for its defence sector needs in ⁠2026.

Britain’s Andy Burnham has urged Ukraine’s allies to provide more Patriot interceptor missiles to Kyiv, saying the country “needs more help to protect its people right now,” PA agency reported. Speaking in Kyiv as he chaired his first meeting of the “coalition of the willing”, the prime minister said the coalition was “doing everything we can all do and working with our allies outside of this coalition to dig into our own stocks and help others dig into their stocks”.

The Coalition of the Willing met online today, co-chaired by Britain’s Andy Burnham from Kyiv. Poland’s foreign minister Radosław Sikorski posted a snap from the meeting , saying France’s Emmanuel Macron , Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Italy’s Giorgia Meloni also spoke during the call.

As European leaders gathered in Kyiv to mark Ukraine’s Independence Day, less than 100 miles (150 kilometres) north, the city of Chernihiv was attacked by Russian forces. Across three waves of attacks, a Russian drone struck an apartment building, injuring 18, the Chernihiv city council posted on Telegram . Two of the injured were children.

Ukraine’s southern Odesa region came under a large-scale Russian missile and drone attack on Monday, with food storage facilities and energy infrastructure among the targets, regional authorities reported. Eighteen people, including two children, were injured in a Russian drone strike on Chernihiv in northern Ukraine, according to Ukraine’s Emergency Service.

reflection.en: The UK's firm stance, declaring that "international borders cannot be changed by force" and pledging "heart and soul" support to Ukraine, echoes the call to seek justice and correct oppression. In a world where nations face aggression, standing with those who suffer, from Lviv to Luhansk, is a powerful act of solidarity. This commitment reflects a moral...
reflection.zh: 英国坚定不移的立场，声明“国际边界不能通过武力改变”，并承诺“全心全意”支持乌克兰，这与寻求公义、纠正欺压的呼召不谋而合。在一个国家面临侵略的世界里，与那些从利沃夫到卢甘斯克受苦的人站在一起，是一种有力的团结行动。这一承诺反映了捍卫弱者和维护公义原则的道德责任。

title.en: DR Congo peace roadmap: Will the fighting finally end?
title.zh: 刚果民主共和国和平路线图：战斗最终会结束吗？

summary.en: A new roadmap sets out the conditions toward peace in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). But disagreements over M23 rebels, Rwanda's role, and security concerns remain, and could still derail the process.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A new roadmap sets out the conditions toward peace in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). But disagreements over M23 rebels, Rwanda's role, and security concerns remain, and could still derail the process.

Representatives of the Congolese government and the Rwanda-backed M23 rebel group agreed on a roadmap for peace after negotiations in Geneva.

It builds on the  US-brokered framework signed in Doha last year, and sets out steps and timelines for negotiations and implementation: a ceasefire monitoring mechanism is also due to receive support from the UN peacekeeping mission, MONUSCO.

The United States, Qatar, the African Union (AU) and Switzerland have all expressed their support for the process as brokers of the push for peace.

However, it is not a full peace plan with bindíng resolutions and terms; rather, many aspects of the push will still need to be fine-tuned.

The new diplomatic initiative could nevertheless be offering fresh hope following ending years of bloody conflict in eastern DRC; fighting in the region has killed hundreds of civilians and displaced millions since 2022, as the M23 rebel group continues to control large parts of North Kivu and South Kivu  — two provinces in eastern DRC, which are highly coveted for their minerals.

As disagreements remain over key issues, doubts continue to cast a shadow  over the prospect of a lasting peace.

For Alex Vines, Africa program director at the European Council on Foreign Relations, the current level of commitment remains fragile: "There are likely to be many more bumps on the road — disagreements remain over issues including sanctions against M23, the release of detainees and the timing of political reforms. So this remains a very fragile commitment," he told DW

Conflict analyst Clifton Chifuwe, executive director of the Centre for Peace Research and Advocacy (CPRA), a local NGO that focuses on conflict management, agrees with that assessment, pointing to the presence of multiple armed groups in the area, the deep level of mistrust between Kinshasa and Kigali, and competition over eastern Congo's mineral wealth.

He believes that the biggest of the challenges across the board is to turn this roadmap into action: "Signing it is easier than implementing it on the ground," he explains.

Chifuwe told DW that independent monitoring mechanisms and the involvement of all key stakeholders will be essential for any peace to hold.

Rwanda has repeatedly rejected accusations that it backs M23 rebels — though international groups maintain the view that the small neighboring nation is deeply entrechned in the conflict .

body.zh: 新的路线图规定了刚果民主共和国东部实现和平的条件。但围绕“3·23”叛军、卢旺达的角色和安全担忧的分歧仍然存在，并且仍可能使这一进程脱轨。 刚果政府和卢旺达支持的M23叛乱组织的代表在日内瓦谈判后就和平路线图达成一致。 它以去年在美国斡旋的多哈签署的框架为基础，规定了谈判和实施的步骤和时间表：停火监测机制也将得到联合国维和特派团联刚稳定团的支持。 美国、卡塔尔、非洲联盟 (AU) 和瑞士都作为推动和平的中间人表示支持这一进程。 然而，这并不是一个包含有约束力的决议和条款的完整和平计划；相反，推动的许多方面仍需要进行微调。 尽管如此，在刚果民主共和国东部结束多年的血腥冲突之后，新的外交举措可能会带来新的希望；自 2022 年以来，该地区的战斗已造成数百名平民死亡，数百万人流离失所，因为 M23 叛乱组织继续控制北基伍和南基伍（刚果民主共和国东部的两个省份）的大部分地区，这两个省的矿产资源备受觊觎。 由于在关键问题上仍存在分歧，疑虑继续给持久和平的前景蒙上阴影。 对于欧洲对外关系委员会非洲项目主任亚历克斯·瓦因斯来说，目前的承诺水平仍然脆弱：“道路上可能还会有更多的坎坷——在制裁‘3·23’运动、释放被拘留者和政治改革的时间安排等问题上仍存在分歧。因此，这仍然是一个非常脆弱的承诺，”他告诉德国之声 冲突分析师克利夫顿·奇富韦（Clifton Chifuwe）是当地一家专注于冲突管理的非政府组织和平研究与宣传中心（CPRA）的执行主任，他同意这一评估，并指出该地区存在多个武装团体、金沙萨和基加利之间存在深厚的不信任，以及对刚果东部矿产财富的竞争。 他认为，全面的最大挑战是将这个路线图转化为行动：“签署它比实际实施更容易，”他解释道。 奇富韦告诉德国之声，独立的监督机制和所有主要利益攸关方的参与对于维持和平至关重要。 卢旺达一再否认其支持 M23 叛乱分子的指控，尽管国际组织仍然认为这个邻国小国深深卷入了冲突。 “卢旺达的诚意及其......

title.en: Is UK's Storm Shadow missile a game changer for Ukraine?
title.zh: 英国的“风暴之影”导弹能改变乌克兰战局吗？

summary.en: Correspondent Joe Inwood breaks down the weapons technology that could make a difference in the Russia-Ukraine war.
summary.zh: 记者乔·因伍德分析了可能改变俄乌战争局势的武器技术。

body.en:
The UK has handed secret blueprints to Ukraine that will allow the country to build its own long-range cruise missiles.

The announcement came during Andy Burnham's first visit to Kyiv as prime minster, where he met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

But faced with an almost daily barrage of Russian ballistic missiles, correspondent Joe Inwood explains why the offer may not be enough to win the war.
body.zh: 英国已向乌克兰提交了秘密蓝图，该蓝图将允许该国建造自己的远程巡航导弹。 这一消息是在安迪·伯纳姆作为总理首次访问基辅期间宣布的，他在那里会见了乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基。 但面对几乎每天都会出现的俄罗斯弹道导弹，记者乔·因伍德解释了为什么这一提议可能不足以赢得战争。

reflection.en: The news of the UK providing Ukraine with blueprints for long-range cruise missiles highlights the ongoing search for military advantage in a protracted conflict. While nations grapple with the realities of war, the prophet Isaiah offers a vision where instruments of destruction are transformed into tools for life. This reminds us to pray for a future where...
reflection.zh: 英国向乌克兰提供远程巡航导弹蓝图的消息，凸显了在旷日持久的冲突中，各国仍在寻求军事优势。当各国努力应对战争的现实时，先知以赛亚描绘了一个愿景，在那里，毁灭的工具被转化为生命的工具。这提醒我们为未来祷告，愿目前用于“风暴之影”导弹等武器的智慧，能转而用于建立持久和平和耕耘大地。

title.en: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
title.zh: 阻止进入赞比亚法院，选举请愿截止日期临近

summary.en: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing. Court premises in the Zambian capital, Lusaka, and elsewhere have been shut as the deadline for filing a petition against the outcome of the recent presidential election approaches.
summary.zh: 赞比亚总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马的第二次就职典礼准备工作似乎仍在进行。随着针对近期总统选举结果提交请愿书的截止日期临近，赞比亚首都卢萨卡及其他地区的法院已被关闭。

body.en:
Court premises in the Zambian capital, Lusaka, and elsewhere have been shut as the deadline for filing a petition against the outcome of the recent presidential election approaches.

An unusual police presence has been reported at some courts, which have been taped off to prevent access.

Opposition candidate Brian Mundubile said he would challenge the election result, citing irregularities, after coming second with a 38% share of the vote. Incumbent Hakainde Hichilema won a second term with 60%.

Mundubile is in hiding over alleged threats made against him, amid a post-election period marked by controversy, including the shooting dead of an opposition figure and the arrest of others.

Monday is the last day on which petition against the presidential election result can be filed. Such a petition could potentially affect the inauguration of Hichilema, which is scheduled for 1 September.

One lawyer told the BBC that three armed men approached his vehicle, identified themselves, and instructed him to leave the area.

The courts that have been sealed off include the High Court in Lusaka, the Supreme Court, which also houses the Constitutional Court, and several local courts.

It is unclear when the premises will reopen. The BBC has contacted the Zambian police and the judiciary for comment.

Local media cite a directive by a judiciary administrative official telling all staff not to report to work following the closure of courts for "security reasons".

The memo, which has also been shared online by some opposition figures, does not give details of the security situation.

Some commentators have raised concerns over the closure while questioning the independence of the judiciary.

A prominent voice for the opposition, Emmanuel Mwamba, alleged the action was aimed at preventing Mundubile from filing his presidential election petition.

The Law Association of Zambia (LAZ) said it was concerned by the closure of the courts and the presence of heavily armed military personnel around court premises in Lusaka.

It said there was no formal public explanation for the closure nor its expected duration.

Referring to the "unsigned memorandum" from the judiciary addressing staff, it said no further official information had been provided to lawyers and the public.

It said the timing was "particularly significant in the present electoral context", citing a "seven-day period" in which a person may "petition the Constitutional Court to nullify the election of a President-elect".

Despite the court closure, preparations for Hichilema's inauguration appear to be continuing.

The youth and sport ministry has issued a media invitation for journalists to accompany a cabinet official on an inspection of arrangements at National Heroes Stadium, where the ceremony is...
body.zh: 随着针对最近总统选举结果提交请愿书的截止日期临近，赞比亚首都卢萨卡和其他地方的法院已关闭。 据报道，一些法院出现了不同寻常的警察存在，并已用胶带封锁以防止进入。 反对党候选人布赖恩·蒙杜比莱 (Brian Mundubile) 表示，他将以 38% 的选票位居第二，以违规行为为由，对选举结果提出质疑。现任总统哈坎德·希奇莱马 (Hakainde Hichilema) 以 60% 的支持率赢得第二个任期。 在大选后充满争议的时期，包括枪杀一名反对派人士和逮捕其他人等事件，蒙杜比莱因涉嫌受到威胁而躲藏起来。 周一是针对总统选举结果提出请愿的最后一天。此类请愿书可能会影响定于 9 月 1 日举行的希奇勒马就职典礼。 一名律师告诉英国广播公司，三名武装人员走近他的车辆，表明身份，并指示他离开该地区。 被封锁的法院包括卢萨卡高等法院、最高法院（也设有宪法法院）和几个地方法院。 目前尚不清楚该场所何时重新开放。 BBC已联系赞比亚警方和司法部门征求评论。 当地媒体援引一名司法行政官员的指示，要求所有工作人员在法院因“安全原因”关闭后不要上班。 该备忘录也被一些反对派人士在网上分享，但没有提供安全局势的详细信息。 一些评论员对关闭表示担忧，同时质疑司法机构的独立性。 反对派的知名人士伊曼纽尔·姆万巴 (Emmanuel Mwamba) 声称，这一行动旨在阻止蒙杜比莱提交总统选举请愿书。 尽管法院关闭，希奇莱马就职典礼的准备工作似乎仍在继续。 青年和体育部已向媒体发出邀请，邀请记者陪同内阁官员检查预计将在国家英雄体育场举行仪式的安排。 蒙杜比莱上周拒绝接受总统选举结果，并表示他计划通过法庭对结果提出质疑。 他仍处于安全地点，受到其竞选活动所称的“国际人权机构”的保护。 在安全官员的一次突袭中，反对派人士被捕，前部长穆托维·卡夫瓦亚（Mutotwe Kafwaya）死亡，他躲藏起来，官员们称这次袭击是在首都一次安全行动中发生的交火。 卡夫瓦亚的逮捕和死亡促使人权组织和赞比亚法律协会呼吁独立......

reflection.en: The news from Zambia, where courts in Lusaka and elsewhere have been shut to prevent an election petition, highlights the fragility of justice when legal avenues are obstructed. When the very institutions meant to uphold the law become inaccessible, it creates a profound sense of despair and raises questions about the integrity of the system. In such...
reflection.zh: 赞比亚卢萨卡及其他地区法院被关闭，以阻止提交选举请愿书的消息，凸显了当法律途径受阻时，公义的脆弱性。当本应维护法律的机构变得无法进入时，会产生深刻的绝望感，并引发对制度诚信的质疑。在这样的时刻，我们想起圣经中对“律法弛缓，公义永不显明”的哀叹，并为所有人恢复公平开放的法律程序而祷告。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
title.zh: 以色列警告将对加沙放飞的风筝做出“强有力”反应

summary.en: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Israel has warned Hamas that it will increase strikes on Gaza following concern over launches of kites, drones and balloons from the territory.

Several kites were found in an Israeli community near the border with Gaza over the weekend, local media reported.

"Forceful actions will be taken to put an end to this phenomenon," Israel's Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Monday.

Before the war, kites and balloons carrying incendiary devices were launched into Israel, causing fires that burned forest and farmland.

Hamas has denied responsibility for the new kites - which were not carrying explosives - and said they belonged to "children searching for their innocent childhood amid the rubble".

The group also accused Israel of using the kites as a "pretext" for continued air strikes in Gaza despite the ceasefire agreed last October.

Four kites were found in Kibbutz Nahal Oz, which is about 800m (2,620ft) from the Gaza border, on Friday and Saturday. Several more were found elsewhere in southern Israel last week, according to local media.

The Israeli reports cited military sources as saying they believed Hamas was behind the kites and that they might have been intended to test Israel's response.

No suspicious materials were attached to the kites and they did not pose a threat, the military said.

But Katz warned there would be "zero tolerance" and said: "A balloon is treated like a kite, and a kite is treated like a drone, with or without explosives."

Residents of Nahal Oz said in a statement that they feared the return of incendiary kites and balloons, adding: "We will not accept a policy of containment when it comes to our security."

Hamas warned of "the danger of the allegations and threats" from Israel and said the kites were "basically children's toys from displacement camps".

"These threats are based on fabricated pretexts and are an attempt to justify the continuation of the aggression and violations against our people," a spokesman for the group added.

On Sunday, Palestinian health officials said two people were killed and seven others injured in two Israeli strikes in Nuseirat refugee camp and the town of al-Zawayda, both in central Gaza.

A four-year-old boy called Mohammed Taha was killed when a building in al-Zawayda, just north of Maghazi refugee camp, was bombed, according to local media.

The Israeli military said it killed the commander of a Hamas weapons manufacturing site in the Maghazi area, whom it identified as Ismail Abu Ful, and that it had warned the residents to evacuate beforehand.

"There is no ceasefire, there is nothing," Abu Ahmed, a displaced man who had been sheltering nearby, told Reuters news agency. "We want solutions, we want to live in peace."

title.en: Iran protest victim: 'They were shooting to kill'
title.zh: 伊朗抗议受害者：‘他们是想杀人’

summary.en: DW spoke with several Iranians affected by a brutal crackdown at the hands of the Tehran's security forces during the height of massive public protests in January.
summary.zh: 德国之声采访了几位受一月份大规模公众抗议高潮期间德黑兰安全部队残酷镇压影响的伊朗人。

body.zh: 德国之声采访了几名受到德黑兰安全部队在一月份大规模公众抗议活动最激烈期间残酷镇压影响的伊朗人。 2026 年 1 月，就在美国和以色列对伊朗发动袭击的几周前，数千名伊朗人冒着生命危险参加了德黑兰政权有史以来规模最大、范围最广的公众起义。 由于对经济困难的不满，抗议活动于 2025 年 12 月开始，但范围和规模很快扩大。 由情报部、巴斯基民兵和伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）组成的政权安全部队在街头向抗议者开枪和殴打。 镇压的规模引起了国际社会的谴责。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普曾一度威胁要对该政权进行军事打击作为回应，并告诉抗议者“援助正在路上”。 但帮助始终没有到来。由于随后的战争给血腥镇压的后果蒙上了阴影，对伊朗公众挺身而出反对政权的支持从议程上消失了。 目前尚无 2026 年 1 月抗议活动中死伤人数的准确数字。伊朗当局估计死亡人数超过 3,100 人。 然而，国际特赦组织强调，由于抗议期间互联网被关闭、镇压规模以及受害者家属面临的压力，实际死亡人数可能要高得多。 总部位于美国的伊朗人权活动组织 (HRANA) 确认了 7,000 多人死亡，并对数千人进行了调查。 血腥镇压七个月后，受害者面临着永久性的身体残疾，同时失去了工作或接受教育的机会。 从伊朗境内获取信息既困难又危险，出于安全考虑，德国之声的采访伙伴选择使用化名。德国之声能够通过人权网络联系受害者。 一名抗议者马苏德在德黑兰郊外的一座城市的示威活动中被数百颗弹丸击伤，数月以来一直没有得到治疗，几天前被埋葬。 据不愿透露具体位置的亲属称，马苏德首先头部被弹丸击中。一名便衣警察随后向他的大腿开枪，并反复踢伤口，导致他的股骨从髋关节脱臼。 马苏德几个月来一直在与伤病作斗争。他的亲戚为他在家筹集治疗费用，他接受了多次手术，但感染不断复发和蔓延。马苏德在生命的最后几天拒绝接受进一步的治疗，他的兄弟说这让他为给家人带来“如此大的负担”而感到羞愧。 哈米德·赫马特普尔 (Hamid Hemmatpour) 是一名医生兼董事会...

reflection.en: The report of Tehran's security forces 'shooting to kill' unarmed protesters highlights the grave danger faced by a populace under oppressive rule. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a predatory animal to a helpless people, causing immense suffering and fear. In such times, the human spirit longs for leaders who protect their citizens...
reflection.zh: 德国之声报道德黑兰安全部队“开枪杀人”手无寸铁的抗议者，凸显了民众在压迫性统治下所面临的严重危险。箴言28:15提醒我们，邪恶的统治者对无助的百姓来说，如同凶猛的野兽，带来巨大的痛苦和恐惧。在这样的时刻，人类灵魂渴望那些保护公民而非恐吓他们的领导者。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
title.zh: 美国财政部长称，伊朗面临“史上最大规模金融攻势”

summary.en: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.
summary.zh: 斯科特·贝森特表示，美国将切断与伊朗的所有经济联系，任何与伊朗进行金融合作的国家也将被孤立。

body.en:
The US treasury secretary has threated Iran with "the single greatest financial offensive ever", claiming the US-Israel war with Iran was "entering its endgame".

Scott Bessent said the US would sever all economic ties with the country in "an economic D-Day" and that any nation partnering with Iran financially would also be isolated.

Bessent's threat to the Iranian regime follows several U-turns and extended deadlines from US President Donald Trump's administration on previous threats.

Iran dismissed Bessent's comments and said it would shut down all oil exports from the region "if the war continues", according to news agency Reuters.

The Iranian regime has also issued a new warning to shipping not to pass through the Strait of Hormuz without its permission, the agency reported.

One fifth of the world's oil and gas usually passes through strait, a waterway south of Iran, but the flow has been effectively blocked by the country since the conflict began at the end of February.

Bessent made the comments in an opinion piece for the Financial Times , external . He did not detail what the economic pressure on Iran would involve, but he is expected to do so in a press conference in the US at 13:00 local time (18:00 BST) on Monday.

"The world should understand that our objective is to sever every economic lifeline that sustains the tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone," he wrote in the piece.

The US has made several threats to Iran over the course of its war with the country, including Trump saying in April that "a whole civilisation will die tonight" unless Iran agreed a deal to end the war and unblock the Strait of Hormuz.

The US eventually climbed down from that position after mediator Pakistan intervened and called for more diplomacy.

The economic impact of the Iran war is being felt in the US and across the world. Higher oil prices have fuelled concerns over the cost of living, with petrol and diesel prices much higher than they were a year ago.

In the US, gasoline prices have surpassed $4 a gallon and affordability is among the top concerns of American voters ahead of the mid-term elections in November.

On Monday, a barrel of Brent crude, the global benchmark for oil prices, was $93.

Last week, Bessent announced the US government would intervene in the bond markets and buy back more government debt in a bid to boost demand for bonds and lower borrowing rates.

But the impact of the annoucenment was short-lived, with long-term borrowing costs bouncing back up a day later.

Former US president Barack Obama and several US allies had agreed a deal with the country in 2015 which lifted many sanctions in return for Iran agreeing to limit its nuclear programme.

However, Trump pulled out of that deal in 2018, calling it "defective at its...
body.zh: 美国财政部长以“有史以来最大规模的金融攻势”威胁伊朗，声称美以与伊朗的战争“已进入尾声”。 斯科特·贝森特表示，美国将在“经济诺曼底登陆”期间切断与伊朗的所有经济联系，任何与伊朗进行经济合作的国家也将被孤立。 贝森特对伊朗政权发出威胁之前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府对之前的威胁多次态度大转变并延长了最后期限。 据路透社报道，伊朗驳斥了贝森特的言论，并表示“如果战争继续下去”，它将关闭该地区的所有石油出口。 据该机构报道，伊朗政权还向航运发出新警告，未经其许可，不得通过霍尔木兹海峡。 世界上五分之一的石油和天然气通常要经过伊朗以南的海峡，但自二月底冲突爆发以来，该国实际上已经封锁了该海峡。 贝森特在外部《金融时报》的一篇评论文章中发表了上述评论。他没有详细说明对伊朗的经济压力将涉及哪些内容，但预计他将在周一当地时间 13:00（英国夏令时 18:00）在美国举行的新闻发布会上详细说明。 他在文章中写道：“世界应该明白，我们的目标是切断维持暴政政权的每一条经济命脉，直到德黑兰独立。” 美国在与伊朗的战争过程中多次向伊朗发出威胁，其中包括特朗普在四月份表示，除非伊朗同意达成协议以结束战争并解除对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁，否则“整个文明将在今晚消亡”。 在调解人巴基斯坦介入并呼吁更多外交努力后，美国最终放弃了这一立场。 美国和全世界都感受到了伊朗战争的经济影响。油价上涨引发了人们对生活成本的担忧，汽油和柴油价格远高于一年前。 在美国，汽油价格已超过每加仑 4 美元，负担能力是 11 月中期选举前美国选民最关心的问题之一。 上周，贝森特宣布美国政府将干预债券市场并回购更多政府债务，以提振债券需求并降低借贷利率。 但该公告的影响是短暂的，长期借贷成本在一天后反弹。 美国前总统巴拉克·奥巴马(Barrack Obama)和几个美国盟友于2015年与伊朗达成协议，取消了多项制裁，以换取伊朗同意限制其核计划。 然而，特朗普于 2018 年退出了该协议，称其“其核心存在缺陷”，并重新实施了美国对伊朗的所有制裁。 在乔·拜登担任美国总统期间...

Romans 12:18 reminds us of the profound challenge, yet vital call, to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us. In a world...
reflection.zh: 美国财政部长宣布对伊朗发动“史上最大规模金融攻势”，威胁切断所有经济联系并孤立其合作伙伴，这凸显了国际关系的紧张局势。罗马书12:18提醒我们，尽管面临巨大挑战，但我们仍被呼召尽力与众人和睦相处。在一个以经济战相威胁的世界里，这节经文鼓励我们在深刻分歧中，也要寻求和解与相互尊重的道路。

title.en: Myanmar: Why Rohingya refugees can't return
title.zh: 缅甸：罗兴亚难民为何无法返回

summary.en: Nine years after the Rohingya were driven from Myanmar, claims of progress on refugee returns have revived talk of repatriation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Nine years after the Rohingya were driven from Myanmar, claims of progress on refugee returns have revived talk of repatriation.

Myanmar's military-backed government is again talking about bringing Rohingya refugees home from refugee camps in neighboring Bangladesh. 

Earlier this month, authorities in Naypyidaw, Myanmar's capital, said they had made progress verifying Rohingya refugees in  Bangladesh for possible repatriation.

Of the 820,000 names submitted by Bangladesh, Myanmar said it had verified around 308,000 as former residents but would not repatriate them until security conditions improve in civil war-torn Rakhine State.

But analysts told DW that large-scale, safe repatriation is now arguably further out of reach than at any point since 2017. Myanmar is engulfed in civil war, the military no longer controls most of Rakhine state , and the Rohingya are denied citizenship.

In August 2017, Myanmar's military launched sweeping operations in northern Rakhine state after alleged attacks by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA) militant group on security posts.

More than 750,000 Rohingya, a long-persecuted Muslim ethnic minority in predominantly Buddhist Myanmar, fled to Bangladesh, joining hundreds of thousands displaced by earlier crackdowns.

Muslim-majority Bangladesh now hosts around 1.2 million Rohingya refugees, mostly in camps around the southern coastal district of Cox's Bazar, according to UN bodies.

Myanmar does not recognize the Rohingya as one of its 135 officially recognized ethnic groups and has long referred to them as "Bengalis," implying they are migrants from Bangladesh despite generations of Rohingya having lived in Rakhine.

UN investigators found evidence of genocidal intent by Myanmar's military, while the United States argued in 2022 that members of the military had committed genocide and crimes against humanity against the Rohingya.

A genocide case brought by the West African nation of Gambia against Myanmar remains before the International Court of Justice in The Hague.

Myanmar's 2021 coup triggered a nationwide civil war that is still raging, even after a much-criticized election earlier this year saw the formation of a civilian government, which remains dominated by officials from the military and junta .

"Safe repatriation is simply not possible," Ronan Lee, a researcher at Loughborough University and author of the 2021 book "Myanmar's Rohingya Genocide," told DW.

There is a civil war in Myanmar and the economy has collapsed, Lee said, meaning a return under present conditions would carry a high risk of the Rohingya facing violence from the military.

body.zh: 罗兴亚人被赶出缅甸九年后，难民回返方面取得进展的说法重新引发了有关遣返的讨论。 缅甸军方支持的政府再次讨论将罗兴亚难民从邻国孟加拉国的难民营带回家。 本月早些时候，缅甸首都内比都当局表示，他们在核实孟加拉国罗兴亚难民是否可能被遣返方面取得了进展。 缅甸表示，在孟加拉国提交的 82 万姓名中，已核实约 30.8 万人为前居民，但在饱受内战蹂躏的若开邦安全状况改善之前不会将他们遣返。 但分析人士告诉德国之声，大规模、安全的遣返现在可以说比2017年以来的任何时候都更加遥不可及。缅甸陷入内战，军队不再控制若开邦大部分地区，罗兴亚人被剥夺公民身份。 2017 年 8 月，在若开罗兴亚救世军 (ARSA) 激进组织据称袭击安全哨所后，缅甸军方在若开邦北部发起了扫荡行动。 超过 75 万罗兴亚人逃往孟加拉国，加入了因早期镇压而流离失所的队伍。罗兴亚人是缅甸佛教占主导地位的长期受迫害的穆斯林少数民族。 据联合国机构称，穆斯林占多数的孟加拉国目前收容了约 120 万罗兴亚难民，其中大部分居住在科克斯巴扎尔南部沿海地区周围的难民营中。 缅甸不承认罗兴亚人是其 135 个官方承认的民族之一，并且长期以来一直将他们称为“孟加拉人”，这意味着尽管罗兴亚人世代居住在若开邦，但他们是来自孟加拉国的移民。 联合国调查人员发现了缅甸军方有种族灭绝意图的证据，而美国则在 2022 年辩称，军方成员对罗辛亚人犯下了种族灭绝罪和反人类罪。 西非国家冈比亚针对缅甸提起的种族灭绝案件仍在海牙国际法院审理。 缅甸 2021 年的政变引发了一场仍在激烈进行的全国性内战，尽管在今年早些时候的一场备受批评的选举中组建了一个仍由军方和军政府官员主导的文职政府。 拉夫堡大学研究员、2021 年出版的《缅甸罗辛亚种族灭绝》一书的作者罗南·李 (Ronan Lee) 告诉德国之声：“安全遣返根本不可能。” 李说，缅甸正在发生内战，经济已经崩溃，这意味着在目前的情况下，罗辛亚人的回归将面临面临军方暴力的高风险。 “缅甸政府由 2017 年种族灭绝驱逐罗兴亚人的同一支军队主导，”李补充道。 “缅甸的生活...

title.en: Scientists discover new 'immune hubs' in skull bone marrow
title.zh: 科学家在头骨骨髓中发现新的“免疫中心”

summary.en: In mouse skull marrow, 'immune hubs' that actively defend the brain have been discovered. Similar cells exist in human skulls, but their role remains unclear.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
In mouse skull marrow, 'immune hubs' that actively defend the brain have been discovered. Similar cells exist in human skulls, but their role remains unclear.

The skull has traditionally been regarded largely as armor for the brain. New research from the United States  suggests it may have another role: proactively helping to defend what lies beneath it.

Researchers at Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis identified previously unknown immune "security stations" in the bone marrow of mouse skulls.

The lymph node-like structures responded to brain tumors before more distant lymph nodes in the neck did. When researchers disrupted the structures in mice with glioblastoma, an aggressive brain cancer , the tumors grew faster and the animals died sooner.

"The skull should no longer be viewed simply as a protective shell around the brain," senior study author Jonathan Kipnis told DW.

"It contains specialized immune environments that appear capable of responding locally to changes within the brain."

The discovery, published in the journal "Nature," comes with an important caveat: The researchers have so far only demonstrated how the structures function in mice, not humans.

Kipnis cautioned that the human evidence remains preliminary: "We found similar immune cells in human skull marrow, suggesting that related structures may exist, but we have not yet demonstrated that they are organized or function in the same way as those in mice," he said.

For much of the 20th century, the brain was described as "immune privileged" — unusually protected from immune activity because inflammation that is useful elsewhere can damage delicate brain tissue.

The blood-brain barrier, which tightly controls what can pass from the bloodstream into brain tissue, reinforced the idea that the brain was largely isolated from the body's conventional immune system.

Researchers now know that the brain communicates continuously with the immune system, particularly through tissues surrounding the brain. 

Kipnis' lab helped drive that rethink in previous work, first by identifying lymphatic vessels in the membranes surrounding the brain and later by showing tiny channels connecting those membranes to the skull's bone marrow.

"The traditional concept of immune privilege has already changed substantially," Kipnis said. "Our findings add another layer by showing that specialized immune structures exist within the skull bone marrow, immediately adjacent to the brain."

The researchers tracked proteins moving from mouse brains through microscopic skull channels and into the bone marrow.

body.zh: 在小鼠头骨骨髓中，发现了积极保护大脑的“免疫中枢”。人类头骨中也存在类似的细胞，但它们的作用仍不清楚。 传统上，头骨在很大程度上被视为大脑的盔甲。美国的新研究表明，它可能还有另一个作用：主动帮助保卫其之下的东西。 圣路易斯华盛顿大学医学院的研究人员在小鼠头骨的骨髓中发现了以前未知的免疫“安全站”。 淋巴结样结构对脑肿瘤的反应先于颈部更远的淋巴结。当研究人员破坏患有胶质母细胞瘤（一种侵袭性脑癌）的小鼠体内的结构时，肿瘤生长得更快，动物死亡也更快。 研究资深作者乔纳森·基普尼斯 (Jonathan Kipnis) 告诉德国之声：“头骨不应再被简单地视为大脑周围的保护壳。” “它包含专门的免疫环境，似乎能够对大脑内的变化做出局部反应。” 这一发现发表在《自然》杂志上，但有一个重要的警告：研究人员迄今为止只证明了这些结构如何在小鼠身上发挥作用，而不是在人类身上。 基普尼斯警告说，人类证据仍处于初步阶段：“我们在人类颅骨骨髓中发现了类似的免疫细胞，这表明可能存在相关结构，但我们尚未证明它们的组织或功能与小鼠的免疫细胞相同，”他说。 在 20 世纪的大部分时间里，大脑被描述为“免疫特权”——异常地受到免疫活动的保护，因为在其他地方有用的炎症会损害脆弱的脑组织。 血脑屏障严格控制着从血液进入脑组织的物质，它强化了大脑在很大程度上与人体传统免疫系统隔离的观点。 研究人员现在知道大脑与免疫系统持续沟通，特别是通过大脑周围的组织。 基普尼斯的实验室在之前的工作中帮助推动了这一重新思考，首先通过识别大脑周围膜中的淋巴管，然后通过显示连接这些膜与头骨骨髓的微小通道。 “免疫特权的传统概念已经发生了很大的变化，”基普尼斯说。 “我们的研究结果又增加了一层内容，表明紧邻大脑的头骨骨髓内存在专门的免疫结构。” 研究人员追踪了从小鼠大脑通过微观颅骨通道进入骨髓的蛋白质。 他们在那里发现了有组织的所谓 B 细胞和 T 细胞簇。 T 细胞帮助 B 细胞“产生大量强大的抗体，帮助对抗......

title.en: The 'tsunami' Zelenskyy doesn't want Ukraine to face
title.zh: 泽连斯基不希望乌克兰面临的“海啸”

summary.en: Ukraine hasn't held elections since Russia's full-scale invasion, but tensions have been brewing over the issue. President Zelenskyy has rebuffed calls for wartime elections, stating they would be a "tsunami for the state" and "split Ukraine."
summary.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵以来，乌克兰一直没有举行选举，但围绕这一问题，紧张局势一直在酝酿。泽连斯基总统拒绝了战时选举的呼吁，称这将是“国家的灾难海啸”，并会“分裂乌克兰”。

body.en:
More than four years after Russia launched the full-scale invasion that has devastated Ukraine and claimed hundreds of thousands of lives, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is facing a new political challenge: whether to hold elections during wartime.

The issue emerged last week after former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov , who was recently dismissed from his role, called for Zelenskyy to find a way to hold elections while fighting was ongoing.

The move was seen as the biggest challenge to Zelenskyy's leadership since the invasion began in February 2022, with Zelenskyy rebuffing calls for a wartime election.

"Elections right now are a tsunami for the state, which will split Ukraine," he said on Sunday, local time.

"That's why my strategy is to steer the country toward an ending of the war and to preserve an independent and sovereign state."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

National elections have been suspended since the invasion began and polling shows most Ukrainians support delaying a vote until the fighting ends.

Zelenskyy won Ukraine's 2019 presidential election in a landslide and would have ordinarily served a five-year term.

After Russia launched its full-scale invasion, Ukraine introduced martial law, which suspends some civil liberties, including national elections.

Zelenskyy's presidential term expired in 2024, but he remained in office as Ukraine's constitutional and legal system provides for continuity of government during martial law. The country's parliament has also continued operating.

Fighting continues along a front line stretching more than 1,200km, while Ukrainian cities, including the capital Kyiv, remain under regular bombardment from Russian drones and missiles.

An election would potentially require millions of Ukrainians to travel to polling stations, creating security risks and raising concerns about how voting could be conducted safely.

Political parties would also need to campaign while the country remained under attack, while authorities would have to find a way for hundreds of thousands of soldiers serving on the front line to vote.

As of the end of June, more than 4.4 million Ukrainians had temporary protection status in the European Union, meaning Ukraine would have to organise hundreds of polling stations across Europe.

Nearly four million Ukrainians have also been internally displaced, making voter registration more difficult and potentially diverting resources from the war effort.

Then there are those living under Russian occupation unable to vote. Ukrainian officials estimated that, as of 2024, around 4.5 million adult Ukrainians remained in Russian-occupied territory.

body.zh: 俄罗斯发动全面入侵，摧毁了乌克兰并夺走了数十万人的生命，四年多后，乌克兰总统泽连斯基面临着新的政治挑战：是否在战时举行选举。 上周，最近被免职的前国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫呼吁泽伦斯基找到在战斗仍在进行时举行选举的方法，此后这个问题出现了。 此举被视为自 2022 年 2 月入侵开始以来对泽伦斯基领导层的最大挑战，泽伦斯基拒绝了进行战时选举的呼吁。 “现在的选举对国家来说就像一场海啸，这将分裂乌克兰，”他在当地时间周日表示。 “这就是为什么我的战略是引导国家结束战争并维护一个独立和主权的国家。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 自入侵开始以来，全国选举一直暂停，民调显示大多数乌克兰人支持推迟投票直至战斗结束。 泽连斯基以压倒性优势赢得乌克兰 2019 年总统选举，任期通常为五年。 俄罗斯发动全面入侵后，乌克兰实施了戒严令，暂停了一些公民自由，包括全国选举。 泽连斯基的总统任期于 2024 年届满，但由于乌克兰宪法和法律制度规定戒严期间政府的连续性，他仍留任。该国议会也继续运作。 战斗在绵延 1,200 多公里的前线继续进行，而包括首都基辅在内的乌克兰城市仍经常受到俄罗斯无人机和导弹的轰炸。 选举可能需要数百万乌克兰人前往投票站，这会带来安全风险，并引发人们对如何安全进行投票的担忧。 政党还需要在国家仍然受到攻击的情况下开展竞选活动，而当局则必须找到一种方式让数十万在前线服役的士兵投票。 截至6月底，超过440万乌克兰人在欧盟拥有临时保护身份，这意味着乌克兰将不得不在欧洲各地组织数百个投票站。 近四百万乌克兰人也在国内流离失所，这使得选民登记更加困难，并可能转移战争资源。 还有一些生活在俄罗斯占领下的人无法投票。乌克兰官员估计，截至 2024 年，约有 450 万成年乌克兰人仍留在俄罗斯占领的领土上。 俄罗斯控制...

President Zelenskyy's concern that wartime elections could become a "tsunami" that "split Ukraine" underscores the profound need for sound guidance. reflection.zh: 在国家危机时期，领导人面临巨大压力，需要做出保障人民和维护团结的决定。泽连斯基总统担心战时选举可能成为“分裂乌克兰”的“海啸”，这凸显了对健全指导的深切需求。雅伟的话语提醒我们，一个国家的安全和稳定取决于丰富的智慧谋略，尤其是在驾驭险恶局势时。

title.en: 'Can't abstain from this debate': Pacific nations the next frontier in deep-sea mining
title.zh: “无法回避的辩论”：太平洋国家成为深海采矿的下一个前沿

summary.en: A new report warns that commercial deep-sea mining in the Pacific could begin as early as 2027, driven by increasing rivalry between the United States and China for critical minerals. Pacific nations are reportedly split between the promise of economic benefits and the risk of irreversible damage to the environment...
summary.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国之间对关键矿产的竞争日益加剧，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能最早在2027年开始。据报道，太平洋国家在经济利益的承诺与对环境和当地生计造成不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。

body.en:
Commercial deep-sea mining in the Pacific could begin in months without policy guardrails due to increasing rivalry between the United States and China over critical minerals, a new report warns.

Analysis by the Lowy Institute has found mining could start as early as 2027, with the floor of the Pacific Ocean holding vast quantities of prized resources.

The contest between the world's two biggest economies is being driven by demand created by batteries, weapons systems, and power grids.

The region's nations are split between the promise of economic spoils and the risk of irreversible damage to the ecosystem, fisheries, food security, livelihoods and culture, according to the research.

It argues the absence of an international governance framework for commercial deep-sea mining leaves Pacific states negotiating without internationally agreed protections.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

This also leaves them dependent on individual agreements drafted by companies seeking to mine their ocean floor.

"For the Pacific Island nations caught in the middle of this great power battle for critical mineral supremacy, the economic proposition is difficult to refuse," the Lowy Institute's Connor Graham writes.

"The problem is not that Pacific nations disagree, it is that they are being forced to negotiate individually against parties with vastly more resources, information, and legal capacity, and that the international framework designed to protect them has stalled."

Graham said while Australia was yet to take a clear position on deep-sea mining in the Pacific, it has the standing, relationships, and institutional presence to make an impact.

This includes its membership in the Pacific Islands Forum and as a long-standing ally of the US.

"A commitment to standards that have not been written as a condition for activity that is about to begin is less of a policy, and more of an abstention," he said.

Countries including Australia have started to enter into deals for critical minerals, which are crucial for a number for emerging technologies.

The federal government has announced a $1.2 billion critical minerals strategic reserve to secure the supply of key minerals deemed crucial for Australia's economy and national security.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国在关键矿产方面的竞争日益激烈，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能会在没有政策保护的情况下在几个月内开始。 洛伊研究所的分析发现，采矿最早可能在 2027 年开始，太平洋海底蕴藏着大量珍贵资源。 全球最大的两个经济体之间的竞争是由电池、武器系统和电网产生的需求驱动的。 研究表明，该地区各国在经济收益的承诺和生态系统、渔业、粮食安全、生计和文化遭受不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。 它认为，商业深海采矿国际治理框架的缺乏导致太平洋国家在没有国际商定保护的情况下进行谈判。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这也使得它们依赖于寻求海底采矿的公司起草的单独协议。 洛伊研究所的康纳·格雷厄姆写道：“对于陷入这场争夺关键矿产霸权的大国战争的太平洋岛国来说，这个经济提议很难拒绝。” “问题不在于太平洋国家不同意，而在于它们被迫与拥有更多资源、信息和法律能力的各方进行单独谈判，而旨在保护它们的国际框架已经陷入停滞。” 格雷厄姆表示，虽然澳大利亚尚未对太平洋深海采矿采取明确立场，但它拥有产生影响的地位、关系和机构存在。 这包括它是太平洋岛屿论坛的成员以及美国的长期盟友。 他说：“对尚未作为即将开始的活动条件的标准的承诺与其说是一项政策，不如说是一种弃权。” 包括澳大利亚在内的国家已开始签订关键矿物交易，这对许多新兴技术至关重要。 联邦政府宣布设立 12 亿美元的关键矿产战略储备，以确保对澳大利亚经济和国家安全至关重要的关键矿产的供应。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The prospect of deep-sea mining in the Pacific presents a stark choice for island nations, balancing potential economic gains against the risk of irreversible ecological damage. As the report warns of mining commencing without adequate policy guardrails, the words of 1 Corinthians 10:23 remind us that while many actions may be permissible, not all are truly...
reflection.zh: 太平洋深海采矿的前景给岛屿国家带来了严峻的选择，需要在潜在的经济收益与不可逆转的生态破坏风险之间取得平衡。正如报告警告，在缺乏充分政策保障的情况下，采矿可能即将开始，哥林多前书10:23提醒我们，虽然许多事情是合法的，但并非所有事情都有益处或能造就人。这种情况呼唤智慧，以辨别什么能真正造就社区并保护雅伟的创造，而不是仅仅追求权宜之计。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Volodymyr Zelenskyy forced to rule out elections as he faces an enemy from within
title.zh: 泽连斯基在面对内部敌人时被迫排除举行选举的可能性

summary.en: A former defence minister has urged Ukraine's leader to hold elections, despite their suspension following Russia’s invasion.
summary.zh: 一名前国防部长敦促乌克兰领导人举行选举，尽管俄罗斯入侵后选举已被暂停。

body.en:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says it would be too dangerous for Ukraine to hold an election while fighting Russia, after a call by his former defence minister to organise a vote.

As he fended off the political pressure, Zelenskyy announced a new drone deal with Norway, as European leaders arrived for talks ahead of a meeting on Monday to discuss how to pressure Russia to end its invasion.

Ukraine has suspended elections under martial law, a measure still widely supported by the population as the country focuses on fighting off the Russian invasion launched in 2022.

The Ukrainian leader has previously faced calls both from Russian President Vladimir Putin and United States President Donald Trump to stage a vote, even as Russia rains down missiles and drones across the country on a daily basis.

"I believe that in a war like this, elections as such are a huge risk," Zelenskyy said during a briefing with journalists on Saturday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"If we want to destroy the country, then we can move in the direction of elections during these times of war," he added.

Ukraine has been engulfed in a political crisis over the summer, triggered when Zelenskyy fired popular defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov . The row forced Zelenskyy to sack his commander-in-chief.

Thousands took to the streets to demand his reinstatement, while Fedorov issued blistering attacks against the army's top brass.

Then, days ago, the ousted Fedorov made a surprise call to find a way to organise elections.

While he did not explicitly state that he wanted to challenge Zelenskyy, the shock move made even some of his supporters distance themselves.

They include how soldiers, millions of Ukrainian refugees and people from occupied territories would cast their ballots, as well as the threat of both interference and physical attacks from Russia.

Only 15 per cent of Ukrainians believe elections should be held before the end of hostilities, according to an opinion poll.

Zelenskyy, despite facing growing domestic criticism as the war drags on, remains largely popular.

Fedorov's team confirmed to Agence France-Presse on Sunday that he plans to visit the US soon — a trip likely to revive speculation about whether he is positioning himself as a rival to Zelenskyy.

The former minister was a prominent backer of the drone warfare strategy that has come to dominate Ukraine's war with Russia, and had pushed for army reforms — winning support among the public.

On Sunday, several European leaders met Zelenskyy in Kyiv for a Nordic-Baltic summit.

Following individual meetings with several leaders, Zelenskyy announced a drone deal with Norway...
body.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基在前国防部长呼吁组织投票后表示，在与俄罗斯作战的同时举行选举对乌克兰来说太危险了。 在顶住政治压力的同时，泽伦斯基宣布了与挪威达成的一项新的无人机协议，欧洲领导人在周一的会议之前抵达进行会谈，讨论如何向俄罗斯施压，使其结束入侵。 乌克兰根据戒严令暂停了选举，这一措施仍受到民众的广泛支持，因为该国专注于抵御 2022 年发起的俄罗斯入侵。 这位乌克兰领导人此前曾面临俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普呼吁进行投票的呼吁，尽管俄罗斯每天都在全国各地发射导弹和无人机。 “我相信，在这样的战争中，选举本身是一个巨大的风险，”泽连斯基在周六向记者举行的吹风会上说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “如果我们想摧毁这个国家，那么我们可以在战争时期朝着选举的方向前进，”他补充道。 今年夏天，乌克兰陷入了一场政治危机，起因是泽连斯基解雇了受欢迎的国防部长米哈伊洛·费多罗夫。这次争吵迫使泽伦斯基解雇了他的总司令。 数千人走上街头要求恢复他的职务，而费多罗夫则对军队高层进行了猛烈攻击。 然后，几天前，被赶下台的费多罗夫突然呼吁寻找组织选举的方法。 虽然他没有明确表示要挑战泽连斯基，但这一令人震惊的举动甚至让他的一些支持者也敬而远之。 其中包括士兵、数百万乌克兰难民和被占领土人民如何投票，以及来自俄罗斯的干涉和人身攻击的威胁。 一项民意调查显示，只有 15% 的乌克兰人认为应该在敌对行动结束之前举行选举。 尽管随着战争的拖延，泽连斯基面临着越来越多的国内批评，但他仍然很受欢迎。 费多罗夫的团队周日向法新社证实，他计划很快访问美国——这次访问可能会再次引发人们对他是否将自己定位为泽伦斯基竞争对手的猜测。 这位前部长是无人机战战略的重要支持者，该战略已在乌克兰与俄罗斯的战争中占据主导地位，并推动了军队改革，赢得了公众的支持。 周日，几位欧洲领导人在基辅会见了泽连斯基，参加北欧-波罗的海峰会。 在与几位领导人单独会面后，泽伦斯基宣布与挪威达成无人机协议……

reflection.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy faces an unenviable task, balancing the democratic ideal of elections with the immediate necessity of national defense against Russia's invasion. His decision to rule out elections, despite calls from a former defense minister, underscores the profound wisdom required to navigate such a complex crisis. In moments when...
reflection.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基面临着一项令人羡慕的任务，他必须在民主选举的理想与抵御俄罗斯入侵的紧迫国家防御之间取得平衡。尽管一名前国防部长呼吁举行选举，但他排除举行选举的决定，凸显了在应对如此复杂危机时所需的深刻智慧。在领导人必须为了人民的利益权衡相互竞争的善时，雅伟的忠告能提供清晰和洞察力。

title.en: Faster than Usain Bolt: The five-day robot Olympics putting humanoid autonomy to the test
title.zh: 比尤塞恩·博尔特更快：为期五天的机器人奥运会考验人形机器人的自主性

summary.en: The World Humanoid Robot Games test the limits of technology and innovation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Humanoid robots are racing, lifting, throwing and even playing tennis in Beijing this week, as China puts its rapidly advancing robotics industry through its paces.

The five-day World Humanoid Robot Games bring together more than 50 events, from traditional sports such as the 100m sprint and tug-of-war to challenges modelled on factory floors, restaurants, offices and emergency scenes.

But behind the spectacle and record-breaking times, the real competition is less about how fast a robot can run than how well it can cope when things go wrong.

Organisers are testing whether machines can see, think and respond to the messy unpredictability of the real world, and whether they can eventually perform useful work without a human stepping in.

The games, heavily promoted in Chinese state media, feature 51 events, including 30 sports competitions and 21 scenario-based contests.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

More than 40 per cent of the events require robots to operate fully autonomously, according to Huawei, a tech partner of the games.

The event is in its second year, and some robots are already outperforming the 2025 results.

On Saturday, two robots ran faster than Usain Bolt's 9.58-second world record in the 100m sprint. That was a sharp improvement from 2025, when the winning robot's time was more than 20 seconds.

Braking was an issue, as the machines slammed into a thick mat that organisers placed several metres after the finish line.

Another humanoid, the same model as the 100m champion, ran 400 metres in 39.7 seconds, faster than South African Wayde van Niekerk's world record of 43.03 seconds.

"The intensity is higher than last year, which places significant demands on the robot's battery management and thermal dissipation capabilities," said spectator and robotics investor Xu Qiaosheng.

Robots will compete in tug-of-war and weightlifting, while Tai Chi and pitch-pot — in which contestants throw arrow-like sticks into a narrow-necked vase — will give traditional Chinese sports a futuristic twist.

Beyond the spectacle, the more revealing tests could come when robots encounter the small imperfections of the physical world: a cable at the wrong angle, an object just out of reach, a shifting package or a missed step.

That tests whether robots can identify objects, accurately position their hands and bodies, apply controlled force and recover from errors without human intervention.

Lumos Robotics Chief Executive Yu Chao said the games could help improve hardware and provide a showcase for the industry. But Yu said the longer-term value will depend on real-world problem solving.

"Only when it can work in those end scenarios...

title.en: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
title.zh: 中国调查使用甲醛保鲜白菜事件

summary.en: Chinese authorities have launched an investigation into reports of formaldehyde, a prohibited carcinogen, being used to preserve cabbages for human consumption. The footage, verified by officials in Hebei province, shows individuals dipping cabbages in a solution before loading them for transport. China is the world's...
summary.zh: 中国当局已对有关使用甲醛（一种被禁的致癌物质）保鲜供人食用的白菜的报道展开调查。河北省官员证实，他们已核实了显示有人将白菜浸入溶液中，然后装车运输的视频。中国是世界上最大的白菜生产国。

body.en:
Authorities in China have launched an investigation into reports of formaldehyde being used to preserve the freshness of cabbages for human consumption.

Officials in the north-eastern Hebei province confirmed that they had verified footage showing individuals dipping cabbages in a solution before loading them onto trucks for transportation.

An environmental blogger first released the footage last week. Using formaldehyde, a colourless chemical used for preserving biological specimens that is known to cause cancer, for keeping food fresh is strictly prohibited in China.

China is the world's largest producer of cabbages, most of which are exported to neighbouring countries in Asia.

Police have taken legal action against the individuals involved, according to state media.

Officials are now moving swiftly to prevent panic and restore confidence by carrying out spot checks on markets across the country.

Chinese state media says investigators will also establish how widespread the practice is and take measures to trace affected vegetables.

Local authorities in Kangbao county said in a statement issued on Saturday: "Any illegal or non-compliant practices discovered will be dealt with strictly in accordance with the law to ensure the safety of the vegetable supply."

Xinfadi market in Beijing, one of the major sources of fresh produce in the capital, issued a statement saying that it had investigated the source of its cabbages, adding that none of the affected vegetables had entered its market.

An editorial in the People's Daily wrote: "The wholesalers focused solely on their immediate economic interests while completely disregarding the lives and health of consumers. [They] crossed a legal red line and breached the moral bottom line."

China produces well over 30 million tonnes of cabbages each year, nearly half of the world's annual total. Vietnam, South Korea and Russia are among the largest export destinations for the vegetable.

Exposure to relatively high quantities of formaldehyde in some workplaces has been linked to some types of cancer in humans, but the effect of exposure to small amounts is less clear, according to the American Cancer Society.
body.zh: 中国当局已对有关使用甲醛来保鲜供人类食用的卷心菜的报道展开调查。 河北省东北部的官员证实，他们已经核实了一段视频，显示人们将卷心菜浸入溶液中，然后装上卡车进行运输。 一位环保博主上周首次发布了这段视频。中国严格禁止使用甲醛（一种用于保存生物样本的无色化学物质，已知会致癌）来保鲜食物。 中国是世界上最大的卷心菜生产国，大部分出口到亚洲邻国。 据官方媒体报道，警方已对涉案人员采取法律行动。 官员们现在正在迅速采取行动，通过对全国市场进行抽查来防止恐慌并恢复信心。 中国官方媒体称，调查人员还将确定这种做法的普遍程度，并采取措施追踪受影响的蔬菜。 康保县当地政府在周六发布的一份声明中表示：“对发现的违法违规行为，将依法严肃处理，确保蔬菜供应安全。” 北京新发地市场是首都生鲜农产品的主要来源之一，该市场发表声明称，已对大白菜的来源进行调查，并补充说，受影响的蔬菜尚未进入该市场。 《人民日报》的一篇社论写道：“批发商只顾眼前的经济利益，完全不顾消费者的生命健康。他们跨越了法律红线，突破了道德底线。” 中国每年生产超过3000万吨的卷心菜，几乎占世界年产量的一半。越南、韩国和俄罗斯是蔬菜最大的出口目的地之一。 据美国癌​​症协会称，在某些工作场所接触相对较高含量的甲醛与人类某些类型的癌症有关，但接触少量甲醛的影响尚不清楚。

title.en: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
title.zh: 近三百万辆特斯拉因隐藏式门把手在中国被召回

summary.en: China has issued its largest car recall, affecting over 4 million electric vehicles, including nearly three million Teslas, due to safety concerns over hidden door handles that are difficult to operate in emergencies. Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi, and Geely are also included in the recall.
summary.zh: 中国发布了有史以来最大规模的汽车召回，涉及超过400万辆电动汽车，其中包括近300万辆特斯拉，原因是隐藏式门把手存在安全隐患，在紧急情况下难以操作。小鹏、小米和吉利等中国汽车品牌也在此次召回之列。

body.en:
Minimalistic door handles became a signature feature of electric vehicles (EVs), but the controversial designs are now at the centre of China's biggest car recall, affecting more than 4 million vehicles.

The recall, which includes 2.98 million Chinese-made Teslas, follows safety concerns that the hidden door handles are difficult to locate and open in emergency situations.

Other brands affected by the recall include Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely.

The recalled vehicles will have a warning label stuck on the interior door and receive a software update to automatically lower the windows in a crash.

The designs have come under scrutiny after two fatal crashes in China involving Xiaomi EVs, in which power failures were suspected to have prevented doors from being opened.

Tesla said in a statement on Friday that it was recalling some of its Model 3, Y, S and X vehicles due to door handles that are "difficult to identify and operate because their colour is similar to the interior trim".

"In extreme situations such as a severe collision causing the vehicle's low-voltage system to fail, this could hinder occupants from quickly opening the doors to escape and impede rescue efforts by those outside the vehicle, posing a safety hazard," it said.

Tesla said it would place warning labels on the recalled vehicles and issue a software update to automatically lower a vehicle's windows after a collision.

It is not clear if the affected firms plan to make a similar recall for the rest of the world.

The use of hidden handle designs has "snowballed" after Chinese brands were quick to copy the "sleek" look of Tesla's Model S sedan since 2014, said Tu Le, the founder of consultancy Sino Auto Insights.

The use of warning labels and a software update is more of a "band-aid" than a lasting solution for the issue, he added.

Under new rules due to take effect on 1 January 2027, cars will only be allowed to be sold in China if they have a mechanical release on both the inside and outside of their doors.

Tesla's door handles were also involved in a probe by US safety regulators after reports that they suddenly stopped working, leaving children trapped in the cars.

In July, the US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration suggested creating a new formal safety standard for all carmakers.

How do you feel about the sleek blended in door handles? Do you have other concerns?

body.zh: 简约的可伸缩门把手已成为电动汽车 (EV) 的标志性特征，但这一颇具争议的设计目前已成为中国最大汽车召回事件的核心，影响了超过 400 万辆汽车。 此次召回包括 298 万辆中国制造的特斯拉，出于安全考虑，隐藏式门把手在紧急情况下难以找到和打开。 受此次召回影响的其他品牌包括中国汽车制造商小鹏汽车、小米和吉利。 隐藏式门把手因亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的特斯拉而广受欢迎，其设计可以无缝地塞入汽车门板内，只有当车主接近车辆时才会向外伸出。 在中国发生两起涉及小米电动汽车的致命事故后，该设计受到了严格审查，其中怀疑是电源故障导致车门无法打开。 特斯拉在周五的一份声明中表示，由于车门把手“难以识别和操作，因为其颜色与内饰相似”，该公司正在召回部分 Model 3、Y、S 和 X 车型。 这可能会阻碍乘员或救援人员在紧急情况下快速打开车门，例如在“严重碰撞导致车辆低压系统发生故障”期间。 特斯拉表示，将在召回的车辆上贴上警告标签，并发布软件更新，以在发生碰撞后自动降低车辆车窗。 目前尚不清楚受影响的公司是否计划对世界其他地区进行类似的召回。 咨询公司Sino Auto Insights的创始人涂乐表示，自2014年以来，中国品牌迅速模仿特斯拉Model S轿车的“时尚”外观，隐藏式把手设计的使用已“滚雪球”。 他补充说，使用警告标签和软件更新更像是一种“创可贴”，而不是问题的持久解决方案。 根据将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的新规定，只有车门内侧和外侧均装有机械解锁装置的汽车才允许在中国销售。 特斯拉的门把手也受到美国安全监管机构的调查，此前有报道称，特斯拉的门把手突然停止工作，导致儿童被困在车内。 7月，美国国家公路交通安全管理局建议为所有汽车制造商制定新的正式安全标准。

reflection.en: The recall of nearly three million Teslas and other electric vehicles in China over hidden door handles reminds us that innovation must always be tempered with practical wisdom. While sleek designs are appealing, the potential for these handles to hinder escape in an emergency situation underscores the need for foresight in engineering. Yahweh's wisdom...
reflection.zh: 中国召回近三百万辆特斯拉及其他电动汽车，原因是隐藏式门把手存在安全隐患，这提醒我们创新必须始终与实用智慧相结合。虽然流线型设计很吸引人，但这些门把手在紧急情况下可能妨碍逃生，这突显了工程设计中预见性的重要。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们考虑所有可能的结果，确保便利性和美观性不会损害安全和福祉。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: 'Can't abstain from this debate': Pacific nations the next frontier in deep-sea mining
title.zh: “无法回避的辩论”：太平洋国家成为深海采矿的下一个前沿

summary.en: A new report warns that commercial deep-sea mining in the Pacific could begin as early as 2027, driven by increasing rivalry between the United States and China for critical minerals. Pacific nations are reportedly split between the promise of economic benefits and the risk of irreversible damage to the environment...
summary.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国之间对关键矿产的竞争日益加剧，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能最早在2027年开始。据报道，太平洋国家在经济利益的承诺与对环境和当地生计造成不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。

body.en:
Commercial deep-sea mining in the Pacific could begin in months without policy guardrails due to increasing rivalry between the United States and China over critical minerals, a new report warns.

Analysis by the Lowy Institute has found mining could start as early as 2027, with the floor of the Pacific Ocean holding vast quantities of prized resources.

The contest between the world's two biggest economies is being driven by demand created by batteries, weapons systems, and power grids.

The region's nations are split between the promise of economic spoils and the risk of irreversible damage to the ecosystem, fisheries, food security, livelihoods and culture, according to the research.

It argues the absence of an international governance framework for commercial deep-sea mining leaves Pacific states negotiating without internationally agreed protections.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

This also leaves them dependent on individual agreements drafted by companies seeking to mine their ocean floor.

"For the Pacific Island nations caught in the middle of this great power battle for critical mineral supremacy, the economic proposition is difficult to refuse," the Lowy Institute's Connor Graham writes.

"The problem is not that Pacific nations disagree, it is that they are being forced to negotiate individually against parties with vastly more resources, information, and legal capacity, and that the international framework designed to protect them has stalled."

Graham said while Australia was yet to take a clear position on deep-sea mining in the Pacific, it has the standing, relationships, and institutional presence to make an impact.

This includes its membership in the Pacific Islands Forum and as a long-standing ally of the US.

"A commitment to standards that have not been written as a condition for activity that is about to begin is less of a policy, and more of an abstention," he said.

Countries including Australia have started to enter into deals for critical minerals, which are crucial for a number for emerging technologies.

The federal government has announced a $1.2 billion critical minerals strategic reserve to secure the supply of key minerals deemed crucial for Australia's economy and national security.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 一份新报告警告称，由于美国和中国在关键矿产方面的竞争日益激烈，太平洋地区的商业深海采矿可能会在没有政策保护的情况下在几个月内开始。 洛伊研究所的分析发现，采矿最早可能在 2027 年开始，太平洋海底蕴藏着大量珍贵资源。 全球最大的两个经济体之间的竞争是由电池、武器系统和电网产生的需求驱动的。 研究表明，该地区各国在经济收益的承诺和生态系统、渔业、粮食安全、生计和文化遭受不可逆转损害的风险之间存在分歧。 它认为，商业深海采矿国际治理框架的缺乏导致太平洋国家在没有国际商定保护的情况下进行谈判。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这也使得它们依赖于寻求海底采矿的公司起草的单独协议。 洛伊研究所的康纳·格雷厄姆写道：“对于陷入这场争夺关键矿产霸权的大国战争的太平洋岛国来说，这个经济提议很难拒绝。” “问题不在于太平洋国家不同意，而在于它们被迫与拥有更多资源、信息和法律能力的各方进行单独谈判，而旨在保护它们的国际框架已经陷入停滞。” 格雷厄姆表示，虽然澳大利亚尚未对太平洋深海采矿采取明确立场，但它拥有产生影响的地位、关系和机构存在。 这包括它是太平洋岛屿论坛的成员以及美国的长期盟友。 他说：“对尚未作为即将开始的活动条件的标准的承诺与其说是一项政策，不如说是一种弃权。” 包括澳大利亚在内的国家已开始签订关键矿物交易，这对许多新兴技术至关重要。 联邦政府宣布设立 12 亿美元的关键矿产战略储备，以确保对澳大利亚经济和国家安全至关重要的关键矿产的供应。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The prospect of deep-sea mining in the Pacific presents a stark choice for island nations, balancing potential economic gains against the risk of irreversible ecological damage. As the report warns of mining commencing without adequate policy guardrails, the words of 1 Corinthians 10:23 remind us that while many actions may be permissible, not all are truly...
reflection.zh: 太平洋深海采矿的前景给岛屿国家带来了严峻的选择，需要在潜在的经济收益与不可逆转的生态破坏风险之间取得平衡。正如报告警告，在缺乏充分政策保障的情况下，采矿可能即将开始，哥林多前书10:23提醒我们，虽然许多事情是合法的，但并非所有事情都有益处或能造就人。这种情况呼唤智慧，以辨别什么能真正造就社区并保护雅伟的创造，而不是仅仅追求权宜之计。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Robot boxing, football and sprinting at World Humanoid Games
title.zh: 机器人拳击、足球和短跑亮相世界人形机器人大赛

summary.en: The second-edition of the five-day competition kicked off in Beijing, China, on Saturday.
summary.zh: 第二届为期五天的世界人形机器人大赛于周六在中国北京拉开帷幕。

body.en:
The competition, which kicked off on Saturday, will run for five days and has already included a robot running faster than Usain Bolt's 100m sprint world record.

Elsewhere at the event in Beijing, a robot performed Cristiano Ronaldo's iconic 'Siuuu' celebration on the football pitch and droids took part in synchronised marching at its opening ceremony.

Robots have also been competing in events including boxing, high jump, Tai Chi and table tennis.

The BBC's China correspondent Stephen McDonell reports from the country's capital.
body.zh: 这场比赛于周六开始，将持续五天，其中已经有一个机器人跑得比尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 的 1 亿短跑世界纪录还要快。 在北京的其他地方，机器人在足球场上表演了克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多标志性的“Siuuu”庆祝动作，并且机器人在开幕式上参加了同步行进。 机器人还参加了拳击、跳高、太极拳和乒乓球等项目的比赛。 英国广播公司 (BBC) 驻华记者史蒂芬·麦克唐纳 (Stephen McDonell) 从该国首都进行报道。

reflection.en: The World Humanoid Games in Beijing, featuring a robot that outran Usain Bolt's 100m record, showcase humanity's remarkable ingenuity and drive for achievement. As we marvel at these technological feats, Yahweh's word reminds us that while athletes strive for a perishable crown, there is a greater, imperishable one to be sought. This perspective encourages...
reflection.zh: 在北京举行的世界人形机器人大赛上，一台机器人跑出了比博尔特100米世界纪录更快的成绩，这展现了人类卓越的创造力和追求成就的动力。当我们惊叹于这些科技壮举时，雅伟的话语提醒我们，运动员们所争取的不过是会朽坏的冠冕，而我们当寻求的，是那永不朽坏的。这种视角鼓励我们在赞美人类创新的同时，将我们最终的盼望根植于真正永恒的事物。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Sam was jailed for helping Hong Kong's protesters. He came home to a city in silence
title.zh: 香港镇压异见，山姆出狱后发现城市一片寂静

summary.en: Six years after China imposed the National Security Law, Hong Kong's crackdown on dissent has spread beyond its borders.
summary.zh: 中国实施《国家安全法》六年之后，香港对异见的镇压已蔓延至境外。

body.en:
Watch Dateline’s latest episode, Hong Kong: A City Silenced, on 25 August at 9.30pm AEST on SBS or SBS On Demand.

At 21, Sam Chan Chi-sum was preparing to leave Hong Kong to continue his studies overseas.

He'd been involved with a student activist group that collected sweets and toiletries to send to people jailed after Hong Kong’s 2019 anti-government protests.

Authorities accused the group of using the supplies to build support among prisoners and incite opposition to the government.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In September 2021, Sam was arrested under Hong Kong’s sweeping National Security Law, which had been passed a year earlier, and was convicted of "subversion with the intent of overthrowing the government".

"Prison was awful. I shared a cell with around twenty people. At its most crowded, there could be forty of us," he said.

He alleged some prison officers purposely mistreated inmates associated with the protest movement.

"I don't know whether they were acting out of personal conviction or following orders. But they certainly made life difficult for us."

Two years after his release from prison, Sam is trying to rebuild a normal life.

He had dreamt of becoming a teacher or a nurse, but his criminal record prevents him from pursuing either career.

"Since being released from prison, I feel as though I've entered a much larger cell," he said.

Instead, he is training to become a documentary filmmaker, determined, he says, to capture the transformation of Hong Kong.

"Whatever the outcome for Hong Kong, whether the future is good or bad, I want to stay here and witness the changes that lie ahead."

Sam’s story is like many other young Hongkongers whose lives have been upended by China’s crackdown on freedoms in Hong Kong, a city once known for its outspoken press, independent judiciary and political opposition.

In 1997, after more than 150 years of British rule, Hong Kong was handed back to China under the "one country, two systems" arrangement that promised Hong Kong would keep a high degree of autonomy.

Like Sam, Carmen Lau was from a generation that came of age after this handover to China: neither British, nor truly Chinese.

As a teenager, Carmen led a student movement in her secondary school against the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) attempt to introduce 'patriotism' lessons in Hong Kong schools.

Many Hongkongers feared it would promote the CCP’s version of patriotism in their city.

"That time was the first time that I was really involved in a social event," said Lau, who’s now 30 and lives in exile in London.

Following large demonstrations, the CCP abandoned its plans...
body.zh: 8 月 25 日晚上 9 点半（澳大利亚东部标准时间）在 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 观看《Dateline》的最新一集《香港：一座沉默的城市》。 21岁的陈志森正准备离开香港到海外继续深造。 他曾参与一个学生活动团体，该团体收集糖果和洗漱用品，寄给香港 2019 年反政府抗议活动后入狱的人。 当局指责该组织利用这些物资在囚犯中赢得支持并煽动反对政府。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 2021年9月，Sam根据一年前通过的香港国家安全法被捕，并被判“颠覆国家政权罪”。 “监狱太糟糕了。我和大约二十个人同住一间牢房。最拥挤的时候，我们可能有四十个人，”他说。 他声称一些监狱官员故意虐待与抗议运动有关的囚犯。 “我不知道他们是出于个人信念还是奉命行事。但他们确实让我们的生活变得困难。” 出狱两年后，萨姆正在努力重建正常的生活。 他曾梦想成为一名教师或护士，但他的犯罪记录阻止了他从事这两种职业。 “自从出狱后，我感觉自己好像进入了一个更大的牢房，”他说。 相反，他正在接受培训，成为一名纪录片制片人，他说，决心捕捉香港的转变。 “无论香港的结果如何，无论未来是好还是坏，我都想留在这里，见证未来的变化。” 萨姆的故事就像许多其他香港年轻人一样，他们的生活因中国对香港自由的镇压而被打乱。这座城市曾经以其直言不讳的新闻界、独立的司法机构和政治反对派而闻名。 1997年，在英国统治150多年之后，香港在“一国两制”安排下回归中国，并承诺香港将保持高度自治。 和 Sam 一样，刘嘉敏也是中国回归后长大的一代人：既不是英国人，也不是真正的中国人。 青少年时期，卡门在中学领导了一场学生运动，反对中国共产党试图在香港学校引入“爱国主义”课程。 许多香港人担心这会在他们的城市宣扬中共版本的爱国主义。 “那次是我第一次真正参与社交活动，”现年 30 岁、流亡伦敦的刘说。 大规模示威后，中共放弃了计划……

reflection.en: The story of Sam returning to a silenced city after imprisonment highlights the profound impact of oppressive rule on a community. Yahweh's word reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a roaring lion, bringing fear and helplessness to the people. In such times, we are called to remember the dignity of every individual and pray for justice and peace.
reflection.zh: 山姆在被囚禁后回到一个寂静的城市，这个故事凸显了压迫性统治对一个社区的深远影响。雅伟的话语提醒我们，邪恶的统治者如同咆哮的狮子，给人民带来恐惧和无助。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召要记住每个人的尊严，并为公义与和平祷告。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: After two decades, China is preparing its boldest Moon mission yet
title.zh: 二十年后，中国正在准备迄今为止最大胆的月球任务

summary.en: China's ambitious space program will take it to the moon as soon as next month, and it's looking for water.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
How do you explore a place where the sun never shines? China's space program will soon embark on one of the most innovative lunar exploration missions in recent years.

We’ve known for nearly two decades that some form of water exists on the moon. What we still don’t know is exactly how much accessible water ice lies inside permanently shadowed craters, how deeply it is buried or what form it takes.

What we do know is that accessing that water ice will be a real challenge: it is found at the bottom of deep, hard-to-traverse craters where the sun never shines, remaining untouched for billions of years at temperatures well below –200C. These are among the most valuable places on the moon, but the hardest to reach and explore.

Lunar exploration has come a long way since the Soviet Union’s Luna-1 probe reached the moon's vicinity in January 1959. The Apollo missions and their successors showed the challenge is no longer simply to reach the moon. It is to explore places human and conventional rovers cannot easily go, and ultimately determine whether the moon itself can provide some of the resources that future explorers will need.

China has spent two decades building an increasingly ambitious lunar exploration program, named after Chang'e, the ancient Chinese goddess of the moon. The Chang'e-7 mission is expected to set course for our celestial neighbour later this month, although a recent failure involving a different Chinese rocket has introduced some uncertainty over the launch date. Here’s what makes this latest mission so interesting.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The mission will test several novel approaches to lunar exploration. It will consist of an orbiter, a lander, a rover and a hopper.

In addition, the Queqiao-2 lunar relay satellite is already in place. Launched separately in March 2024, it subsequently supported the Chang'e-6 mission and will facilitate communication between Earth and the lunar surface during the Chang'e-7 mission.

We don’t know precisely where the mission will land, but a site on or near an illuminated ridge close to the Shackleton crater in the Lunar South Pole’s Aitken region is a prime candidate.

The hopper will be the mission’s real star. Unlike a wheeled rover, it’s designed to leap over broken terrain and descend into craters where sunlight never reaches, places conventional vehicles may simply be unable to enter.

Adding it to the mission makes sense, given the steep crater walls, broken terrain, permanent shadow and the need for autonomous navigation and communications.

Chinese scientists won’t be looking for signs of water; we...
body.zh: 如何探索一个阳光照不到的地方？中国的太空计划很快将启动近年来最具创新性的月球探测任务之一。 近二十年来，我们已经知道月球上存在某种形式的水。我们仍然不知道的是，在永久阴影的陨石坑内到底有多少可接近的水冰，它埋藏的深度有多深，或者它的形式是什么。 我们所知道的是，获取这些水冰将是一个真正的挑战：它是在难以穿越的深坑底部发现的，那里的阳光永远不会照射到，在远低于零下200摄氏度的温度下数十亿年都保持不变。这些是月球上最有价值的地方，但也是最难到达和探索的地方。 自 1959 年 1 月苏联的 Luna-1 探测器到达月球附近以来，月球探索已经取得了长足的进步。阿波罗任务及其后续任务表明，挑战不再仅仅是到达月球。它是为了探索人类和传统漫游车无法轻易到达的地方，并最终确定月球本身是否可以提供未来探险者所需的一些资源。 中国花了二十年的时间制定了一项日益雄心勃勃的月球探测计划，该计划以中国古代月亮女神嫦娥的名字命名。嫦娥七号任务预计将于本月晚些时候飞往我们的天体邻居，尽管最近另一枚中国火箭的失败给发射日期带来了一些不确定性。这就是这个最新任务如此有趣的原因。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该任务将测试几种月球探索的新方法。它将由轨道飞行器、着陆器、漫游车和漏斗组成。 此外，鹊桥二号月球中继卫星也已就位。它于2024年3月单独发射，随后支持嫦娥六号任务，并将在嫦娥七号任务期间促进地球与月球表面之间的通信。 我们不知道任务将在哪里着陆，但月球南极艾特肯地区靠近沙克尔顿陨石坑的照明山脊上或附近的一个地点是主要候选地点。 漏斗将成为这次任务的真正明星。与轮式漫游车不同，它的设计目的是跳过破碎的地形并下降到阳光永远无法到达的陨石坑中，而传统车辆可能根本无法进入这些地方。 考虑到陡峭的火山口壁、破碎的地形、永久的阴影以及自主导航和通信的需求，将其添加到任务中是有意义的。 中国科学家不会寻找水的迹象；而是寻找水的迹象。我们...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. Proverbs 2:6 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with humble learning and wise application, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到智慧、知识与追求真理。Proverbs 2:6提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以谦卑学习与智慧运用来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: 130,000 or 230,000? The migration figures One Nation is trying to explain
title.zh: 13万还是23万？一国组织试图解释的移民数据

summary.en: Conflicting comments from One Nation figures have raised questions about the party's migration target.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has faced questions over his party's immigration target, claiming fellow MP David Farley misspoke when he revealed their figures were "not too different" from Labor's.

The MP for Farrer told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday that One Nation's stated figure of 130,000 net overseas migration annually into Australia did not include those who enter under a Pacific labour scheme, aged-care nurses, and other in-demand skilled workers.

He conceded that those groups would add roughly 100,000 people, bringing their total to 230,000 — 5,000 fewer than the current Labor budget projections.

Party leader Pauline Hanson intervened just hours later, writing on social media that One Nation's policy is to reduce net overseas migration (NOM) to 130,000.

Speaking to Channel Seven's Sunrise program on Monday, Joyce added that Farley simply made a mistake while explaining the numbers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Show me a political career where people haven't made a mistake, and I'll show you a person who's not told the truth," Joyce said.

"I'm not going to throw anybody under a bus. When people are new in parliament, they can sometimes get things incorrect, and that's what happens. God knows, I've done it enough."

The debate over Australia's migration figures has intensified in recent months, with a recent Redbridge/Accent Research poll, conducted for the Australian Financial Review, indicating that voters trust One Nation and its traditionally restrictive approach to handle migration better than Labor or the Liberal Party.

However, the disjointed nature of One Nation's ongoing public discourse on the topic has prompted claims that the party is "incoherent" and "not fit to govern" from federal minister Pat Conroy.

Since its 1997 inception, cutting immigration has been seemingly a foundational pillar of One Nation policy. During her first speech to federal parliament, Hanson alleged Australia was in danger of being "swamped by Asians", that migrants never assimilated, and that multiculturalism should be abolished.

Its website currently states One Nation would "cut immigration by over 570,000 people" through "capping visas at 130,000 per year".

In a social media post on Sunday, Hanson wrote that NOM would be cut to 130,000 — a figure the party has previously clarified to SBS News . This number would be achieved by reducing international students, temporary graduate visas, and a "much more targeted" skilled migration program, Hanson said.

Those figures are different to the ones put forward by Farley, who said One Nation is focusing on "the NOM in its true form", as separate to labour programs "that drive our...
body.zh: 一国党议员巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) 面临有关该党移民目标的质疑，声称同僚议员戴维·法利 (David Farley) 在透露他们的数字与工党的数字“相差不大”时说错了话。 法雷尔议员周日告诉美国广播公司的 Insiders 节目，一国党公布的每年有 13 万名海外净移民进入澳大利亚的数字不包括根据太平洋劳工计划进入的人、老年护理护士和其他急需的技术工人。 他承认这些团体将增加大约 10 万人，使总人数达到 23 万人——比当前工党预算预测少 5,000 人。 几小时后，该党领导人保琳·汉森(Pauline Hanson)介入，她在社交媒体上写道，一国党的政策是将海外净移民(NOM)减少到13万人。 乔伊斯周一在第七频道的《日出》节目中补充说，法利只是在解释这些数字时犯了一个错误。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 乔伊斯说：“向我展示一个人们没有犯过错误的政治生涯，我就会向你展示一个没有说实话的人。” “我不会把任何人扔到公共汽车下。当人们刚进入议会时，他们有时会弄错事情，这就是发生的事情。上帝知道，我已经做得足够多了。” 近几个月来，有关澳大利亚移民数据的争论愈演愈烈，Redbridge/Accent Research 最近为《澳大利亚金融评论》进行的一项民意调查显示，选民相信一国党及其传统的限制性政策，能够比工党或自由党更好地处理移民问题。 然而，一国党持续就这一话题进行的公开讨论的脱节性质促使联邦部长帕特·康罗伊声称该党“语无伦次”且“不适合执政”。 自 1997 年推出以来，减少移民似乎一直是一国政策的基本支柱。汉森在联邦议会的第一次演讲中声称澳大利亚面临“被亚洲人淹没”的危险，移民永远不会被同化，多元文化主义应该被废除。 其网站目前表示，一国党将通过“每年 13 万个签证上限”来“减少超过 57 万移民”。 汉森在周日的社交媒体帖子中写道，NOM 将削减至 13 万人——该党此前已向 SBS 新闻澄清了这一数字。汉森表示，这一数字将通过减少国际学生、临时毕业生签证和“更有针对性”的技术移民计划来实现。 这些数字与法利提出的数字不同，法利表示，一国党正在关注“真正形式的 NOM”，与“推动我们……的劳工计划”分开。
