title.en: Rush to vaccinate little penguins against H5N1 as another seal is diagnosed
title.zh: 随着另一只海豹被诊断出感染H5N1，人们正紧急为小企鹅接种疫苗

summary.en: A second seal in South Australia has likely contracted the H5N1 bird flu virus, prompting an urgent vaccination program for the iconic little penguin population on Phillip Island to prevent further spread.
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚的第二只海豹可能感染了H5N1禽流感病毒，促使菲利普岛紧急启动了为其标志性小企鹅种群接种疫苗的计划，以防止病毒进一步传播。

body.en:
Bird flu has likely spread to a second seal, one day after the first mammal in Australia was confirmed to have contracted the virus.

Five suspected H5 bird flu cases were recorded in South Australia on Monday, including a long-nosed fur seal at The Pages Conservation Park, the state's Department of Primary Industries and Regions said in a statement on Monday morning.

The Pages — which covers two small islands between Kangaroo Island and the mainland — is a haven for the endangered Australian sea lion.

The fur seal has been tested for bird flu, with results expected in the coming days.

The first positive case of the virus in a mammal was confirmed on Sunday in a long-nosed fur seal at Beachport, 300km south of Adelaide, which authorities believed was contracted from wild birds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Before the new case was announced, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the spread from birds to mammals was inevitable and the government was examining whether further vaccination programs were needed.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear. But we also need to be realistic," he told ABC TV on Monday.

"This is what we've seen happen overseas. Australia is very fortunate that we've been the last continent on Earth to have this strain of bird flu happen. But we are likely to see those kind of events as we have overseas."

Agriculture Minister Julie Collins said the federal government was investigating whether bird flu vaccines were available for use in mammals.

"There are trials underway in North America, in California and Hawaii, and this is using a vaccine that's been developed for cattle," she told ABC radio.

"There certainly is nothing commercially available, but we do continue to look at that research."

Bird flu vaccinations have been rolled out to at-risk species, including the little penguins on Victoria's Phillip Island.

Many were corralled into pens to receive the first of two vaccinations on Sunday night.

With case numbers on the rise, authorities have stepped in to do what they can to defend the 5,000-strong colony.

The penguins' nightly ritual of returning to the same burrow, along the same path, made them ideal candidates for vaccination, Phillip Island Nature Parks reserve manager Ben Thomas said.

As a world-first in scale, the process has taken some experimentation and fine-tuning.

"We've had our teams out late into the night for a week now and learning a lot along the process," Thomas said.

title.en: SBS WorldWatch is changing. Here's what viewers need to know
title.zh: SBS WorldWatch 正在发生变化。这是观众需要了解的内容

summary.en: The multilingual news service will cease broadcasting next month and continue exclusively online.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
SBS WorldWatch will soon become a digital-only service, ending its run as a broadcast television channel.

The multilingual news service, which provides news bulletins from international broadcasters, will move entirely to SBS On Demand .

SBS says the shift will allow it to increase the number of bulletins available in most languages.

From 18 September, the channel, which provides international news in 38 languages from 49 broadcasters worldwide, will cease broadcasting and all SBS WorldWatch programming will continue on SBS On Demand.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As the channel closes, SBS WorldWatch will expand its existing digital service over the coming weeks to include two or more daily bulletins in most languages.

This is more content than could be accommodated on a single linear channel, SBS says, allowing audiences to watch bulletins as soon as they become available rather than waiting for a scheduled broadcast.

SBS On Demand also features two 24-hour FAST channels for English-language news — Euronews and France 24 .

SBS Director of News and Current Affairs, Mandi Wicks, said SBS WorldWatch played an important role in connecting Australians with news and perspectives from around the world, in their preferred language.

"Moving to SBS On Demand gives us the opportunity to build on that service, with more international news bulletins and greater flexibility for audiences to decide when and how they watch," she said.

"We recognise this will be a change for some audiences who are accustomed to watching SBS WorldWatch on linear television. We're committed to supporting them through the transition, while continuing to evolve our services for the future."

SBS is providing multilingual information and guidance through SBS Audio language programs and on SBS WorldWatch channel 35 ahead of the change.

Further information is available here , with additional support available via the SBS Help Centre .

The SBS WorldWatch — News In-Language hub can be found on the SBS On Demand homepage , where audiences can also search for content in their preferred language.

The full SBS On Demand offering features more than 15,000 hours of local and international programming across more than 60 languages, spanning news and current affairs, documentaries, drama, world movies, entertainment, food, children’s content and sport.

This includes dedicated language collections, as well as selected English-language programs with subtitles in Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese.

title.en: 'Second chance at life': Sydney woman speaks publicly after surviving shark attack
title.zh: “第二次生命机会”：悉尼女子鲨鱼袭击幸存后首次公开讲话

summary.en: Leah Stewart, 34, a Sydney mother, has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a shark attack over two months ago, attributing her "remarkable" recovery to community support. She expressed gratitude for the "army of love, support, prayers and encouragement" that helped her "get better, not bitter."
summary.zh: 34岁的悉尼母亲莉亚·斯图尔特在两个多月前鲨鱼袭击中幸存后首次公开讲话，她将自己“显著”的康复归功于社区的支持。她对“来自世界各地的爱、支持、祈祷和鼓励大军”表示感谢，这些帮助她“变得更好，而不是心怀怨恨”。

body.en:
A Sydney mother has spoken publicly for the first time since surviving a shark attack more than two months ago, crediting community support with helping her "get better, not bitter".

In a post on her GoFundMe donation page, Leah Stewart, 34, said she still had a long way to go, but her recovery had been "remarkable".

"A huge part of that is because of the absolute army of love, support, prayers and encouragement surrounding my family and I from all over the world," she said.

"That means more to me than I can say, and I truly believe it’s played a huge role in my recovery."

Stewart was swimming between the flags close to shore when she was attacked by a great white shark at Coogee Beach on 13 June.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

She was rushed to hospital in a critical condition, being induced in a coma and undergoing multiple surgeries, including the amputation of one of her arms.

The mother of one said she had been focused on her recovery and had "progressed enough to build some independence, and I can finally see some light after all of this".

"I want you to know that I feel like I’ve been given a second chance at life, and I’m not going to waste it. As I get better, I know I’ll make something of this second chance and aim to give back even more in generosity, care, and love. I will forever be grateful for everything, and everyone, I’ve been given," she said.

Stewart thanked those who had contributed to the fundraiser, which had reached more than $558,000, but it was time to turn donations off.

"What you’ve offered has given us enough to recover, to stay in our home, and to give us options for further medical treatment down the road," she said.

Sydney has experienced a spate of shark attacks this year, including three in just 48 hours in January.

On 18 January, 12-year-old Nico Antic was critically injured and later died after being attacked by a suspected bull shark while swimming off rocks in Vaucluse in Sydney Harbour.

The following day, Andre de Ruyter, 27, was attacked while surfing near Manly, suffering extreme blood loss and undergoing surgery to have one of his legs amputated.

An 11-year-old boy's surfboard was also bitten at Dee Why Beach on the same day, but the young surfer escaped injury.

After Stewart was attacked in June, NSW Premier Chris Minns said his government would invest an extra $34 million in drone coverage across NSW beaches.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .

title.en: Enosh has a 10-year, $600,000 bet on the Australian dream
title.zh: Enosh 为澳大利亚梦下了 10 年 60 万美元的赌注

summary.en: For this young migrant, getting ahead means thinking differently about wealth.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Should you invest in shares, or property? Is university still worth it, or should you start your own business? With the path to financial security becoming less clear, Insight asks how aspirational people are getting ahead, and whether Australia is a good country to build wealth. Watch Insight episode Gettin' Rich at 8.30PM Tuesday 25 August on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Enosh Tampoe, 23, and his family migrated from Sri Lanka 16 years ago and have been living in the same rental property since then.

The Sydney mortgage and finance adviser says that as an immigrant family "starting from scratch", he felt financially behind his friends at times growing up.

"There were situations where I did feel like [I was] potentially behind — just because at the end of the day, there is that intergenerational wealth ...You'll notice obviously, they have their own houses; they have nice cars ..." he told Insight.

"Having that support from parents — whether it's in the form of getting money or continuing to live at home rent-free and all that stuff — definitely helps."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Feeling he couldn't rely on the "whole natural pathway of doing well in school, getting through uni and [getting] a big boy job" to build wealth, he took a hard approach to saving at an early age and bought a Sydney apartment two years ago.

Now, he's giving himself 10 years to save a $600,000 deposit for a $3 million Sydney home where his whole family can live.

"My end goal is … that great Australian dream: owning my own home, building my family and raising them in a nice neighbourhood," he said.

To reach his goal faster, he lives with his parents and rents out his apartment — taking advantage of the tax benefits of negative gearing to build equity.

Negative gearing refers to a situation where the ongoing costs of an investment exceed the rental income received, and the overall loss can then be claimed as a tax deduction.

But as of 1 July 2027, the federal government will restrict the tax benefits of negative gearing to new residential builds.

Enosh says this new law has reduced his borrowing capacity by "around 20 per cent", putting his plans to buy a second investment property this year on hold.

"If I were to purchase a second investment property, I'm not getting that benefit towards my salary or wage, that tax benefit."

Leticia Coco also became a homeowner in her early 20s — when her mother died from cancer, and she and her brother inherited the family home.

body.en: The chairman of the Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company, Jeffrey Lam, has welcomed the government’s decision to grant them an additional 20 percent of land size upon formation carried out by the winning tender of the first large-scale development project at the Northern Metropolis, saying it shows the authorities' determination towards industry development at the site. The Development Bureau on Monday said it awarded a nearly 11-hectare project in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area to HSK New Development Limited which comprises six shareholders: China Overseas Land and Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land, China Travel Service, JD.com and a subsidiary of Sino Land. Apart from flattening and developing three residential sites and building a smart logistics centre on an "Enterprise and Technology Park" site, the consortium will be tasked with forming various remaining sites in the pilot area, to be handed back to the government later. Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said two of the “Enterprise and Technology Park” sites of 4.5 hectares will be granted to Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company upon formation, increasing the size of sites at a nominal land premium for 50 years from 23 hectares to 27.5 hectares, to allow firms to settle in early once the site formation is completed in 2028. Lam said that the decision highlighted the government’s support for the park company and the emphasis on industrial development. He added that the newly allocated sites will help the park company to establish a regional industrial ecosystem at Hung Shui Kiu and enhance its appeal to businesses and talents. Meanwhile, Ryan Ip, vice president of the think-tank Our Hong Kong Foundation, said the winning consortium has expertise in various fields, which will help expedite the development of the mega project. “Each of the corporate has its own merit. You have a developer with long history of local operations, and then you also have large SOE [state-owned enterprise] developers who have strong experience on operating this kind of I&T enterprises on the mainland, and then you also have an established, large logistics operator,” said Ip, who's also a member of the Advisory Committee on the Northern Metropolis. “So I think it bring a lot of different experience to Hong Kong not only on residential development, but also on the operation of technology park, and also on the operations of high-end logistics facilities.” JD.com – the anchor tenant at the centre – will start operations within 55 months, which Ip described as an “aggressive timeline” compared with the minimum requirement of 96 months in the tender documents. “I think they have to work very hard to achieve that not only on a smooth construction schedule, but also they will have to...
body.zh: 洪水桥工业园公司主席林俊杰对政府在北都会首个大型发展项目中标后批出额外20%土地面积的决定表示欢迎，称这显示了当局在该地块发展工业的决心。发展局周一表示，已将洪水桥/厦村新发展区近11公顷的项目批给HSK新发展有限公司，该公司由六家股东组成：中国海外发展、招商局置地、华润置地、中国旅行社、京东以及信和置业的子公司。除了平整和开发三个住宅用地以及在“企业和科技园”用地建设智能物流中心外，该联合体还将负责在试验区内形成各种剩余用地，稍后交还给政府。发展局局长林柏纳黛表示，其中两幅面积为4.5公顷的“企业及科技园”用地将在洪水桥工业园公司成立后批出，以50年名义补地价将用地面积从23公顷增加至27.5公顷，以便企业在2028年用地完成后尽早入驻。林表示，这一决定凸显了政府对园区公司和工业园公司的支持。重视产业发展。他补充，新分配的用地将有助园区公司在洪水桥建立区域产业生态系统，增强对企业和人才的吸引力。与此同时，智库团结香港基金会副总裁叶瑞恩表示，中标财团拥有多个领域的专业知识，这将有助于加快这个大型项目的开发。 “每家企业都有自己的优点。你有一个在本地运营历史悠久的开发商，然后你还有在内地运营此类创科企业方面拥有丰富经验的大型国有企业开发商，然后你还有一个成熟的大型物流运营商，”同时也是北方都市咨询委员会成员的叶说。 “所以我认为它给香港带来了很多不同的经验，不仅是住宅开发，还有科技园的运营，还有高端物流设施的运营。”该中心的主要租户京东将在 55 个月内开始运营，叶先生称，与招标文件中 96 个月的最低要求相比，这是一个“激进的时间表”。 “我认为他们必须非常努力才能实现这一目标，不仅要保证施工进度顺利，而且还必须……

title.en: 'Link workers' help fight elderly loneliness
title.zh: “链接工作者”帮助对抗老年人的孤独感

summary.en: One of Ben Wong's clients is an elderly man who shunned others after his dog died. "At his home, there were only some instant noodles and alcohol," Wong spoke about his client's sense of isolation. The volunteer "link worker" noted it took him some time to gradually get the man...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: One of Ben Wong's clients is an elderly man who shunned others after his dog died. "At his home, there were only some instant noodles and alcohol," Wong spoke about his client's sense of isolation. The volunteer "link worker" noted it took him some time to gradually get the man to open up, revealing more about himself and his beloved four-legged companion. Among the activities planned was a funeral to allow his client to bid farewell to his dog. Accompanied by Wong, he also met with other dog owners and went to parks and markets. "We also took the elderly man to the district elderly community centre, and he even did rehearsals for the centre's Christmas party," Wong said. "He also started to do hotpots with other senior residents and said hi to his friends." Wong, who's in his fifties and an accountant by profession, is training to become a volunteer "link worker" to help elderly people fight their loneliness by linking them with the appropriate activity resources. He is among a batch of 60 "link workers" under a programme that offers "social prescriptions" for some 300 senior citizens in New Territories East, including Tin Shui Wai, Tuen Mun and Yuen Long. "Social Prescribing Lab 2.0", to be launched next year, was organised by Make A Difference Institute, the city's first community-initiative public services innovation lab, to provide personalised services for those in need. The group said Hong Kong is grappling with a "loneliness epidemic", with one in five people reporting they feel lonely. That's higher than the global average of 16 percent. Roughly 520,000 Hongkongers also noted that they are "self-isolating", unwilling to confide in family, friends or even AI, according to surveys. "[For] many of the senior residents, actually they don't have the physical illnesses, what they really need is the 'social prescribing' to help them cope with loneliness," the institute's chairwoman Ada Wong said. Dicky Chow, assistant research director of the think tank, Our Hong Kong Foundation, highlighted the differences between social workers in general and these "social prescribing link workers". He said while social workers offer various types of services, "link workers" bring their clients to the actual social venues or help them access social resources. "'Social prescribing' is actually serving as a bridge between medical and social sectors," Chow said. "It's connecting the social sectors with the healthcare sectors, but at the same time, it is not [done] through just referrals, but more about accompanying the elderly, the patients... go through the whole journey with them. "And this is particularly helpful in solving a lot of health concerns, especially loneliness and chronic diseases, because they're actually affected by social determinants of health...
body.zh: Ben Wong 的一位客户是一位老人，在他的狗死后，他避开了其他人。 “在他的家里，只有一些方便面和酒，”黄谈到他的客户的孤立感。这位志愿者“链接工作人员”指出，他花了一些时间才逐渐让这名男子敞开心扉，透露更多关于他自己和他心爱的四足伙伴的信息。计划的活动之一是举行葬礼，让他的客户告别他的狗。在黄的陪同下，他还与其他狗主人会面，并去了公园和市场。黄说：“我们还带老人到区长者社区中心，他甚至为中心的圣诞晚会进行排练。” “他还开始和其他老人一起做火锅，并向朋友们打招呼。”黄先生五十多岁，职业是会计师，他正在接受培训，成为一名志愿者“联络员”，通过为老年人联系适当的活动资源来帮助他们克服孤独感。他是一项计划中的60名“链接工作者”之一，该计划为新界东（包括天水围、屯门和元朗）的约300名老年人提供“社会处方”。将于明年推出的“社会处方实验室2.0”是由Make A Difference Institute组织的，该实验室是该市第一个社区倡议的公共服务创新实验室，旨在为有需要的人提供个性化服务。该组织表示，香港正在应对“孤独流行病”，五分之一的人表示他们感到孤独。这高于 16% 的全球平均水平。调查显示，大约 52 万香港人还表示，他们正在“自我隔离”，不愿向家人、朋友甚至人工智能倾诉。 “对于许多老年居民来说，实际上他们并没有身体疾病，他们真正需要的是‘社会处方’来帮助他们应对孤独，”该研究所的主席 Ada Wong 说。团结香港基金智囊团助理研究主任周卫健强调了一般社会工作者与这些“社会处方链接工作者”之间的差异。他说，虽然社会工作者提供各种类型的服务，但“链接工作者”将他们的客户带到实际的社交场所或帮助他们获取社会资源。 “‘社会处方’实际上是医疗和社会部门之间的桥梁，”周说。 “它正在将社会部门与医疗部门联系起来，但同时，它不仅仅是通过转介来完成的，而是更多地陪伴老年人、患者……与他们一起经历整个旅程。“这对于解决很多健康问题特别有帮助，特别是孤独和慢性病，因为它们实际上受到健康的社会决定因素的影响......

title.en: China abruptly delays unmanned moon mission over ‘launch conditions’
title.zh: 中国因“发射条件”突然推迟无人登月任务

summary.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket. Photo: CCTV screenshot. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved sending the Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket, “does not meet launch conditions and cannot take place during the planned window this year”. The decision to delay was “based on the principle of prudence, reliability and absolute mission success,” it added, without providing further details on what conditions weren’t met or when the launch would be rescheduled. The mission — meant to search for water on the moon’s south pole — was scheduled to depart either over the weekend or Monday, according to media reports. Last week, the agency said the probe and carrier rocket had been moved to the takeoff area at Wenchang Space Launch Center in southern Hainan province. As of Wednesday, the takeoff site and equipment were in good condition, with inspections to take place and a launch “scheduled for the coming period”. The Chang’e-7 delay comes just under two weeks after media reports showed a rocket launched from the Hainan site had exploded, as crowds watched a fiery ball in the sky. The failed mission involved a Long March 7A carrier rocket, which had lifted off from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, state news agency Xinhua said at the time. China’s Long March 7A carrier rocket exploded on Monday, August 10, 2026. Photo: Supplied. An “anomaly” occurred when the rocket carrying the Zhongxing-4B communications satellite was in flight, Xinhua added. The cause of the failure was under investigation, it said. Beijing has ploughed billions of dollars into its space programme in recent years to achieve what President Xi Jinping calls the country’s “space dream”. China successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in July, according to its space agency, marking a major step in its space ambitions and in reducing launch costs. The country is aiming to land astronauts on the Moon before 2030, a race in which the United States is also competing with its Artemis programme.
body.zh: 中国载人航天局周日表示，将推迟一项研究月球任务，该任务是北京计划在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球的努力的一部分，距离一次罕见的发射失败还不到两周。长征五号运载火箭上的嫦娥七号月球探测器。照片：央视截图。该机构表示，经过“全面评估”，此次由长征五号运载火箭发射嫦娥七号月球探测器的任务“不符合发射条件，不能在今年计划的窗口期进行”。它补充说，推迟的决定是“基于审慎、可靠和任务绝对成功的原则”，但没有提供有关哪些条件不满足或何时重新安排发射的进一步细节。据媒体报道，该任务旨在在月球南极寻找水，计划在周末或周一出发。上周，该机构表示，探测器和运载火箭已转移至海南省南部文昌航天发射中心的起飞区。截至周三，起飞场地和设备状况良好，将进行检查并“计划在未来一段时间内”发射。嫦娥七号的发射推迟不到两周，此前媒体报道称，一枚从海南发射场发射的火箭发生爆炸，当时人群正在观看天空中的一个火球。官方通讯社新华社当时称，此次失败的任务涉及一枚从文昌航天发射场升空的长征七号甲运载火箭。中国的长征七号甲运载火箭于 2026 年 8 月 10 日星期一爆炸。照片：提供。新华社补充说，搭载中星四号B通信卫星的火箭在飞行过程中出现“异常”。声明称，故障原因正在调查中。近年来，北京已在太空计划上投入了数十亿美元，以实现习近平主席所说的国家“太空梦想”。据中国航天局称，中国于 7 月首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，标志着其太空雄心和降低发射成本迈出了重要一步。该国的目标是在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球，美国也在这场竞赛中与其阿耳忒弥斯计划展开竞争。

title.en: Shein to make market debut in Hong Kong next Tuesday

summary.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. Shein app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and HK$49.50, raising up to HK$13.86 billion (US$1.7 billion), it said in a filing to the bourse. The final price will be announced on August 31, but the higher figure would value the company at around US$26.8 billion. Founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, Shein finally won Beijing’s approval last month to make its initial public offering in Hong Kong. Plans to list in New York and London had been held back in recent years by regulatory hurdles, according to media reports. With most of its factories located in China, Shein sets itself apart from its competitors thanks to the speed of its product design and its highly efficient production and supply chain. Its vast selection of products at stunningly low prices has brought Shein into the same league as Amazon in the United States. With the funds raised from the market, Shein said it aims to finance its technological capabilities as well as boost its international presence. Growing scrutiny Shein reported a full-year net profit of US$2.06 billion in 2025 but swung to a $99 million quarterly loss as the United States scrapped an import duty exemption on small packages. The firm moved its headquarters to Singapore between 2021 and 2022, a move analysts say was intended to avoid increasing global scrutiny of Chinese firms. But it still benefits from China’s unique combination of a huge, low-cost textile manufacturing sector and a highly sophisticated e-commerce logistics network. The company ranks suppliers by their flexibility and ability to deliver urgent orders, and regularly eliminates the poorest performers, according to a 2021 Zhongtai Securities report. By the end of last year, its European customer base rose to 156 million average monthly users, making Shein one of the continent’s biggest e-commerce platforms alongside China’s AliExpress (193 million users) and Amazon (around 180 million). Shein has been scrutinised over its environmental footprint and allegations of human rights violations, though its executive chairman told AFP last year that the company has “zero tolerance” on forced labour. Activists from Mouv’Enfants, an association for the protection of children, stage a protest during the opening of Asian e-commerce giant Shein’s first physical store at the Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) in Paris on November 5, 2025. Photo: Mouv’Enfants, via Facebook. Shein also drew criticism last year in France over the discovery of...
body.zh: 这家快时尚零售商周一表示，Shein 将于 9 月 1 日在香港证券交易所上市，这是一次期待已久的上市，该集团的估值将接近 270 亿美元。谢因应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该在线零售商计划以 47.60 港元至 49.50 港元的价格发行 2.8 亿股股票，筹集至多 138.6 亿港元（17 亿美元）。最终价格将于 8 月 31 日公布，但较高的价格将使该公司估值约为 268 亿美元。 Shein 成立于中国，现总部位于新加坡，上个月终于获得北京方面的批准，在香港进行首次公开​​募股。据媒体报道，近年来在纽约和伦敦上市的计划因监管障碍而受阻。 Shein 的大部分工厂位于中国，凭借其产品设计速度以及高效的生产和供应链，使其在竞争对手中脱颖而出。 Shein 的产品种类繁多且价格极低，使其与美国的亚马逊处于同一水平。 Shein 表示，通过从市场筹集的资金，其目标是为其技术能力提供资金并提高其国际影响力。日益严格的审查 Shein 报告称，2025 年全年净利润为 20.6 亿美元，但由于美国取消小包装进口关税豁免，季度亏损 9,900 万美元。该公司在 2021 年至 2022 年间将总部迁至新加坡，分析师称此举是为了避免全球对中国公司日益严格的审查。但它仍然受益于中国庞大、低成本的纺织制造业和高度复杂的电子商务物流网络的独特结合。根据中泰证券 2021 年的报告，该公司根据供应商的灵活性和交付紧急订单的能力对供应商进行排名，并定期淘汰表现最差的供应商。截至去年年底，其欧洲客户群平均每月用户数增至 1.56 亿，使 Shein 成为欧洲大陆最大的电子商务平台之一，与中国的全球速卖通（1.93 亿用户）和亚马逊（约 1.8 亿用户）齐名。 Shein 因其环境足迹和侵犯人权的指控而受到审查，尽管其执行主席去年告诉法新社，该公司对强迫劳动采取“零容忍”态度。 2025 年 11 月 5 日，保护儿童协会 Mouv’Enfants 的活动人士在亚洲电子商务巨头 Shein 在巴黎 Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) 的第一家实体店开业期间举行抗议。照片：Mouv’Enfants，来自 Facebook。去年，谢因在法国也因发现……而受到批评。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: South Africa produces enough food, yet millions face hunger. Better cold storage could help change that
title.zh: 南非生产足够的粮食，但数百万人面临饥饿。更好的冷藏可以帮助改变这一现状

summary.en: South Africa can produce enough food for its population, according to official statistics. But millions face hunger, partly because food is lost and wasted in the value chain. An estimated 10.3 million metric tons of food is wasted annually in the country, 19% of it fresh...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

South Africa can produce enough food for its population, according to official statistics . But millions face hunger, partly because food is lost and wasted in the value chain. An estimated 10.3 million metric tons of food is wasted annually in the country, 19% of it fresh produce.

A substantial portion of this loss and waste occurs during harvesting , transportation and marketing because of handling problems and inadequate infrastructure.

We are agri-food systems specialists who have studied food waste both at the farm level and further along the chain toward consumers. For example, I (Opara) have found that for pomegranates, 15.3% to 20.1% of the harvest is lost at the farm (for several reasons, but mainly sunburn and cracks) and 6.74% to 7.69% at the packhouse (as a result of superficial injuries and missorted fruits from the farm).

Another study (Opara) measured postharvest waste at a produce market. This ranged from 0.68% to 1.26%.

The research confirms that food waste is partly due to inadequacies or failures in the cold chain, especially during summer, when high temperatures affect the physical quality of fresh produce. A cold chain is a temperature-controlled supply chain that keeps perishable products safe and fresh.

My (Opara) recent study assessed the magnitude and seasonal variations of postharvest waste at the wholesale level, using a case study of a fresh produce market in Gauteng province, South Africa. The study used the market's historical fresh produce waste data over three years (2021 to 2023).

The results show that fresh produce is affected by seasonal heat and humidity, which affect its physical quality and consumer acceptability. Fresh produce is marketed and sold based on claims of freshness.

High temperatures typically result in increased moisture loss. If that is uncontrolled, the produce deteriorates and cannot be sold or safely eaten. Across South Africa's seasons, temperatures and humidity levels vary considerably.

Much of the fresh produce waste occurs during summer, often requiring improved handling and storage, as well as maintenance of the cold chain, to preserve quality.

The study shows that about 9,124 to 17,969 metric tons—about 0.68% to 1.26% of the supplied fresh produce—are discarded annually at the fresh produce market. Much of it results from high temperatures during summer, when cold storage facilities are most stretched because of high demand.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 根据官方统计，南非可以为其人口生产足够的粮食。但数百万人面临饥饿，部分原因是食物在价值链中丢失和浪费。据估计，该国每年浪费 1030 万吨食品，其中 19% 是新鲜农产品。 由于处理问题和基础设施不足，大部分损失和浪费发生在收获、运输和营销过程中。 我们是农业食品系统专家，研究了农场层面以及通往消费者的整个供应链中的食物浪费。例如，我（Opara）发现，对于石榴来说，在农场损失了 15.3% 至 20.1% 的收成（原因有多种，但主要是晒伤和裂纹），在包装厂损失了 6.74% 至 7.69%（由于农场的表面损伤和错误分类的水果）。 另一项研究（Opara）测量了农产品市场的收获后废物。范围为 0.68% 至 1.26%。 研究证实，食物浪费部分是由于冷链不足或故障造成的，特别是在夏季，高温影响了新鲜农产品的物理质量。冷链是一种温控供应链，可保持易腐产品的安全和新鲜。 我（奥帕拉）最近的研究通过对南非豪登省新鲜农产品市场的案例研究，评估了批发层面收获后废物的规模和季节变化。该研究使用了市场三年（2021 年至 2023 年）历史生鲜农产品浪费数据。 结果表明，生鲜农产品受季节高温和湿度的影响，影响其物理品质和消费者可接受性。新鲜农产品是根据新鲜度进行营销和销售的。 高温通常会导致水分流失增加。如果不加以控制，产品就会变质，无法出售或安全食用。南非的各个季节，温度和湿度变化很大。 大部分新鲜农产品浪费发生在夏季，通常需要改进处理和储存以及冷链维护，以保持质量。 研究表明，每年约有 9,124 至 17,969 吨（约占所供应新鲜农产品的 0.68% 至 1.26%）被丢弃在新鲜农产品市场上。其中大部分是由于夏季高温造成的，此时冷藏设施因需求量大而捉襟见肘。 通过 Phys.org 获取每日见解的超过 100,000 名订阅者发现科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态。注册我们的免费新闻通讯并获取有关...的更新

title.en: Mechanical memory helps explain how cells adapt their movement to changing environments
title.zh: 机械记忆有助于解释细胞如何使运动适应不断变化的环境

summary.en: Cells in our bodies squeeze through dense tissue channels, thread past neighboring cells and navigate every nook and cranny within the extracellular matrix—the mesh-like network that surrounds and supports cells. How well they do this can shape a wide range of physiological...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Cells in our bodies squeeze through dense tissue channels, thread past neighboring cells and navigate every nook and cranny within the extracellular matrix—the mesh-like network that surrounds and supports cells. How well they do this can shape a wide range of physiological processes, from wound repair to the spread of cancer.

A team led by Assistant Professor Andrew Holle from the Department of Biomedical Engineering at the College of Design and Engineering, National University of Singapore (NUS CDE) has shown that cells can carry a physical memory of the environments they have experienced and that this memory can influence how efficiently they later move through confined spaces.

Crucially, the team identified NFATC2, a member of the NFAT family of transcription factors, as a key regulator of this process. A transcription factor is a protein that helps control which genes are switched on or off. By linking a cell's past mechanical environment to changes in gene activity, NFATC2 appears to help encode and maintain this "mechanical memory"—a finding that could help researchers better understand how cells migrate during cancer metastasis, wound healing and tissue regeneration and inform the design of biomaterials that guide cell behavior.

The study focuses on a question at the core of mechanobiology: How do cells respond to the physical properties of their surroundings? Cells are known to sense whether their environment is soft or stiff. A cell in soft tissue, for example, can behave differently from one on a rigid surface.

What has been less clear is whether those physical experiences persist after a cell moves elsewhere and whether they affect later behavior.

"Cells are usually studied based on where they are at a given moment, but our findings show that where they have been is also important," Holle said. "A cell's physical history can shape how it responds to a new challenge. That gives us another way to think about migration. We can think about it as behavior influenced by both present conditions and past mechanical experience."

To test this, the researchers grew three types of cells on materials of different stiffness: healthy fibroblasts, fibrosarcoma cells and highly invasive breast cancer cells. The cells were first "primed" for several days on soft or stiff hydrogels, then transferred to a common surface or into microchannel devices that mimic the tight spaces cells encounter in tissues.

The team found that fibroblasts and fibrosarcoma cells that had been primed on soft substrates moved more efficiently through very narrow channels than cells primed on...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 我们体内的细胞挤过密集的组织通道，穿过邻近的细胞，并穿过细胞外基质（包围和支撑细胞的网状网络）内的每个角落和缝隙。它们在这方面做得如何可以塑造广泛的生理过程，从伤口修复到癌症扩散。 新加坡国立大学设计与工程学院 (NUS CDE) 生物医学工程系助理教授 Andrew Holle 领导的团队表明，细胞可以携带其所经历的环境的物理记忆，并且这种记忆可以影响它们随后在密闭空间中移动的效率。 至关重要的是，该团队发现 NFATC2（NFAT 转录因子家族的成员）是该过程的关键调节因子。转录因子是一种有助于控制基因开启或关闭的蛋白质。通过将细胞过去的机械环境与基因活性的变化联系起来，NFATC2似乎有助于编码和维持这种“机械记忆”——这一发现可以帮助研究人员更好地了解细胞在癌症转移、伤口愈合和组织再生过程中如何迁移，并为指导细胞行为的生物材料的设计提供信息。 该研究重点关注机械生物学的核心问题：细胞如何对其周围环境的物理特性做出反应？众所周知，细胞能够感知周围的环境是柔软的还是坚硬的。例如，软组织中的细胞的行为可能与刚性表面上的细胞不同。 目前尚不清楚的是，这些身体体验在细胞移动到其他地方后是否仍然存在，以及它们是否会影响以后的行为。 “通常根据细胞在特定时刻所处的位置来研究细胞，但我们的研究结果表明它们曾经所处的位置也很重要，”霍尔说。 “细胞的物理历史可以决定它如何应对新的挑战。这为我们提供了另一种思考迁移的方式。我们可以将其视为受当前条件和过去机械经验影响的行为。” 为了测试这一点，研究人员在不同硬度的材料上培养了三种类型的细胞：健康成纤维细胞、纤维肉瘤细胞和高度侵袭性乳腺癌细胞。这些细胞首先在柔软或坚硬的水凝胶上“引发”几天，然后转移到一个共同的表面或模拟细胞在组织中遇到的紧密空间的微通道装置中。 研究小组发现，在软基质上引发的成纤维细胞和纤维肉瘤细胞比在软基质上引发的细胞更有效地通过非常狭窄的通道移动。

title.en: Corners in focus: Metasurface enables motion tracking without digital image processing
title.zh: 聚焦角落：超表面无需数字图像处理即可实现运动跟踪

summary.en: A research team at City University of Hong Kong (CityUHK) has developed a new optical corner-detection imaging method that uses azimuthal Hilbert transform metasurfaces and is designed to work as a universal framework. The study marks an important advance in high-speed,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A research team at City University of Hong Kong (CityUHK) has developed a new optical corner-detection imaging method that uses azimuthal Hilbert transform metasurfaces and is designed to work as a universal framework. The study marks an important advance in high-speed, low-power optical information processing and has demonstrated potential for motion-tracking applications.

The study was led by Professor Tsai Din-ping, chair professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering at CityUHK. The project was conducted in collaboration with Professor Tao Li from the College of Engineering and Applied Sciences at Nanjing University.

Titled "Optical corner detection with azimuthal Hilbert transform metasurfaces," the study is published in Science Advances .

The inspiration for this research stems from biological vision. Many animals are especially good at noticing geometric features, especially corners. For example, bees are drawn to angular shapes and use their compound eyes to identify sharp structures on flowers, and woodpeckers often peck at the intersections of bark cracks or the edges of holes, where insects are more likely to be hidden.

These examples reflect a common strategy—extracting key information from complex scenes by focusing on local features, such as corners, that stand out clearly. In today's world, where information overload is common, this strategy can help reduce visual complexity and improve both sensing and computational efficiency.

Corner detection is widely used in computer vision, including image registration, motion tracking and 3D reconstruction. Today, most corner detection relies on digital signal processing. However, electronics-based digital processing faces limits in response speed and energy consumption. Photonic or optical processing may offer faster and more energy-efficient performance, but existing optical processing approaches have focused mainly on 2D feature extraction. Practical optical corner-detection methods have been limited.

In this study, the research team built a 4f imaging system and introduced a metasurface at the Fourier plane to modulate the optical field in the angular direction. They used silicon nitride as the metasurface material and optimized the structural parameters based on geometric-phase modulation, enabling efficient broadband operation in the visible spectrum.

They first tested metasurfaces with different designs, demonstrating that corners in different polygon shapes were clearly highlighted in the images. They confirmed stable performance across a range of visible wavelengths, supporting the system's...

title.en: What live sewage spill data does (and doesn't) tell us about water pollution
title.zh: 实时污水泄漏数据告诉我们哪些关于水污染的信息（和没有）

summary.en: During periods of heavy rainfall, pipes known as storm overflows aim to prevent excess water from overflowing into the sewage system. But this is not always the case.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

During periods of heavy rainfall, pipes known as storm overflows aim to prevent excess water from overflowing into the sewage system. But this is not always the case.

During intense rainfall, combined sewers (which carry both wastewater from homes and businesses and rainwater running off roads and buildings into drains) can exceed their capacity. To reduce the risk of sewage flooding homes, businesses and roads , storm overflow pipes can contain excess water.

Then, when the time is right, these pipes can provide a controlled release point for excess water to flow into rivers and the sea. These discharges are legally permitted under very specific conditions, mainly during very heavy rainfall when the sewer network would become overwhelmed. But public concern has grown over how frequently they are used and what effect they may have on the environment .

To address these concerns, since January 2025, water companies in England have been required to publish near-real-time sewage discharge data via websites like Sewage Map or Waterwatch .

The aim was to improve transparency and allow the public, journalists, environmental organizations and researchers to better understand when sewage was entering rivers. For many people, particularly swimmers and other recreational water users, maps that show live discharges have become a way to decide if it's safe to enter the water.

However, there is a problem: The data do not work in the way many people assume they do.

In December 2025, I began monitoring sewage discharges to investigate whether the information could help explain some of the microplastic pollution I was finding in the River Thames. I quickly realized that interpreting the data was far more complicated than expected. The issue was not only that the data changed over time, but that the information being provided did not answer the questions needed to understand environmental impact.

England's event duration monitoring (EDM) system records when a sewage overflow starts and stops operating. Essentially, it tells us how long a discharge appears to have lasted.

The data do not show how much sewage entered a river, lake or coastal water, what pollutants were present, whether the discharge was diluted by rainfall, or what effect it had on aquatic ecosystems . Nor do they measure bacterial contamination or indicate whether the water is safe for swimming. They also cannot tell us whether a spill caused harm to fish, plants or other wildlife.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在大雨期间，被称为风暴溢流的管道旨在防止多余的水溢入污水系统。但情况并非总是如此。 在强降雨期间，合流下水道（将家庭和企业的废水以及从道路和建筑物流入下水道的雨水）可能会超出其容量。为了降低污水淹没家庭、企业和道路的风险，雨水溢流管可以容纳多余的水。 然后，当时机成熟时，这些管道可以为多余的水流入河流和海洋提供受控的释放点。在非常特殊的条件下，这些排放是法律允许的，主要是在大雨期间，下水道网络将不堪重负。但公众越来越担心它们的使用频率以及它们可能对环境造成的影响。 为了解决这些问题，自 2025 年 1 月起，英格兰的自来水公司被要求通过 Sewage Map 或 Waterwatch 等网站发布近乎实时的污水排放数据。 目的是提高透明度，让公众、记者、环境组织和研究人员更好地了解污水何时进入河流。对于许多人来说，尤其是游泳者和其他休闲用水者来说，显示实时排放的地图已成为决定是否安全进入水中的一种方式。 然而，存在一个问题：这些数据并不像许多人想象的那样发挥作用。 2025 年 12 月，我开始监测污水排放，调查这些信息是否有助于解释我在泰晤士河中发现的一些微塑料污染。我很快意识到解释数据比预期复杂得多。问题不仅在于数据随着时间的推移而变化，而且所提供的信息没有回答了解环境影响所需的问题。 英国的事件持续时间监测（EDM）系统记录污水溢出何时开始和停止运行。本质上，它告诉我们放电似乎持续了多长时间。 这些数据没有显示有多少污水进入河流、湖泊或沿海水域，存在哪些污染物，排放物是否被降雨稀释，或者对水生生态系统产生什么影响。它们也不测量细菌污染或表明水是否可以安全游泳。他们也无法告诉我们泄漏是否对鱼类、植物或其他野生动物造成了伤害。 在干燥天气下，在一条小河流中排放一小时的污水可能会与一小时的污水排放产生截然不同的环境影响......

title.en: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
title.zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，世界海洋达到有记录以来的最高温度

summary.en: The record "is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress", according to Dr Samantha Burgess from the European Copernicus climate change service.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The world's oceans are hotter than ever recorded, new data suggests, as they suffer from human-caused climate change and the growing El Niño weather phenomenon.

The average surface temperature of the planet's seas outside the polar regions hit 21.1C (70F) on Saturday, according to figures from the European Copernicus climate change service.

That edges past the 21.09C recorded on three separate days in March 2024, and is far above average for the time of year.

Warmer oceans can have wide-reaching consequences, including supercharging extreme weather, raising sea levels and harming marine life.

"This record is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress," said Dr Samantha Burgess, deputy director of Copernicus.

"El Niño is adding heat to the system, but it is doing so on top of decades of human-driven warming," she added.

The data is based on sea temperatures 10m (32ft 10in) below the surface, using measurements from buoys, ships and satellites, which are combined to produce a global estimate.

While the margin of record is currently very small and any global estimate comes with uncertainties, scientists say its timing is particularly notable.

Average worldwide sea temperatures tend to reach their yearly peak in March or April, which corresponds to the end of summer in the southern hemisphere - and not in August.

The southern hemisphere contains more of the planet's ocean surface than the northern hemisphere and so exerts a bigger influence on average sea temperatures.

What is especially concerning to scientists is that the oceans are already so hot when the natural El Niño weather phenomenon is still some way off its expected peak.

El Niño brings unusually warm waters to the surface of the eastern and central tropical Pacific Ocean. Warmer waters across such a large area means that global average temperatures typically spike too.

El Niño is expected to keep strengthening until Christmas time, with scientists warning that it is on course to be the strongest in centuries .

"The fact that we are already breaking records is an early indicator of how strong the El Niño is becoming," said Dr Jeremy Grist, senior research fellow at the National Oceanography Centre in Southampton.

"All things being equal we might expect the ocean temperature record to be broken again in March [or] April 2027," he added.

The waters far away from El Niño's Pacific hunting ground are also extremely warm, including around the UK and Europe.

The western English Channel has seen almost continuous marine heatwave conditions for more than three years, peaking at 7C above normal in July, according to Prof Tim Smyth, director of science at Plymouth Marine Laboratory.

Scientists say such widespread warmth around the planet is a clear sign of the growing effect...
body.zh: 新数据显示，由于人为气候变化和日益严重的厄尔尼诺天气现象，世界海洋的温度比以往任何时候都要高。 根据欧洲哥白尼气候变化服务机构的数据，周六极地以外的地球海洋表面平均温度达到 21.1 摄氏度（70 华氏度）。 这一气温略高于 2024 年 3 月连续三天记录的 21.09 摄氏度，远高于一年中该时期的平均气温。 海洋变暖可能会产生广泛的影响，包括加剧极端天气、海平面上升和损害海洋生物。 哥白尼副主任萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士说：“这一记录是海洋压力日益增大的又一个明显信号。” 她补充说：“厄尔尼诺现象正在给系统增加热量，但这是在数十年人为导致的变暖的基础上发生的。” 该数据基于海面以下 10 m（32 英尺 10 英寸）的海水温度，使用浮标、船舶和卫星的测量结果，将这些数据结合起来得出全球估计值。 虽然目前的记录差距非常小，而且任何全球估计都存在不确定性，但科学家表示，其时机尤其值得注意。 全球平均海水温度往往在三月或四月达到年度峰值，这对应于南半球的夏末，而不是八月。 南半球比北半球拥有更多的地球海洋表面，因此对平均海洋温度的影响更大。 让科学家们特别担心的是，当自然厄尔尼诺天气现象距离预期峰值还有一段距离时，海洋已经如此炎热。 厄尔尼诺现象给东部和中部热带太平洋表面带来异常温暖的海水。如此大面积的水域变暖意味着全球平均气温通常也会飙升。 厄尔尼诺现象预计将持续增强，直到圣诞节期间，科学家警告称，这将是几个世纪以来最强的一次。 南安普敦国家海洋学中心高级研究员杰里米·格里斯特博士说：“我们已经打破记录这一事实是厄尔尼诺现象变得多么强烈的早期指标。” 他补充道：“在所有条件相同的情况下，我们预计海洋温度记录将在 2027 年 3 月或 4 月再次被打破。” 远离厄尔尼诺现象的太平洋狩猎场的水域也非常温暖，包括英国和欧洲周围的水域。 普利茅斯海洋实验室科学主任蒂姆·史密斯教授表示，三年多来，西英吉利海峡几乎持续出现海洋热浪天气，7月份的最高气温比正常水平高出7摄氏度。 科学家们表示，全球范围内如此广泛的变暖是这种影响日益增强的明显迹象......

body.en: The conservationist Harry Green was a naturalist of the amateur school, with an encyclopedic knowledge of British wildlife based on a lifetime in the field. Though born and brought up in Oxfordshire, he spent the whole of his adult life in his adopted county of Worcestershire. Harry, who has died aged 92, remembered being kept awake during the second world war by calling corncrakes in the meadows near his home. Later he strove, against the odds, to save Britain’s last colony of marsh warblers near Pershore. These, and the corncrakes, eventually vanished, but other species, such as hobbies, little egrets and Cetti’s warblers, did arrive and thrive. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自然资源保护主义者哈里·格林（Harry Green）是一位业余博物学家，凭借在该领域的一生，对英国野生动物有了百科全书式的了解。尽管他在牛津郡出生和长大，但他的整个成年生活都是在他收养的伍斯特郡度过的。已去世 92 岁的哈利记得，在第二次世界大战期间，他因在家附近的草地上叫玉米秧鸡而无法入睡。后来，他克服重重困难，努力拯救英国珀肖尔附近最后的沼泽莺群。这些鸟和玉米秧鸡最终消失了，但其他物种，如白鹭、小白鹭和塞蒂莺，确实出现并繁衍生息。继续阅读...

summary.en: On a panel show last week, everyone in the audience wanted to talk about the climate emergency, but the lines rolled out by a Tory MP simply dissolved on contact with reality As it is August, and everyone with stronger opinions is currently on holiday, last week I went on Any...

body.en: On a panel show last week, everyone in the audience wanted to talk about the climate emergency, but the lines rolled out by a Tory MP simply dissolved on contact with reality As it is August, and everyone with stronger opinions is currently on holiday, last week I went on Any Questions? , the BBC Radio 4 panel show. I had prepared beforehand with a friend whose life’s work it is to make sure people don’t say anything stupid on the radio (or TV), and we’d talked about everything – the strait of Hormuz and energy prices; bus fare caps and the relative price of eggs; racism in the press and in public life; the AI bubble and the next financial crash; how many bathrooms Harry and Meghan currently have in the US, and whether a property even exists in the UK with that amount of toileting hardware. Predictably, perhaps, the audience’s questions did not spread themselves neatly across the full suite of current affairs, though Harry and Meghan’s return did come up – it was more a matter of which question about the climate crisis best represented the fact that everyone wanted to talk about the climate crisis. The news had just dropped that El Niño would deliver us an unprecedentedly wet autumn , but that was unlikely to soothe the parched earth of the record-breakingly hot, dry summer. Crops are failing, the land is on fire and nobody has not noticed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在上周的一场小组节目中，观众中的每个人都想谈论气候紧急情况，但一位保守党议员推出的台词在接触现实后就消失了。由于现在是八月，每个有更强烈意见的人目前都在度假，上周我上了《有问题吗？》。 ，BBC 广播 4 台专题节目。我事先和一位朋友做好了准备，他一生的工作就是确保人们不会在广播（或电视）上说任何愚蠢的话，我们谈论了一切——霍尔木兹海峡和能源价格；公交车票价上限和鸡蛋的相对价格；新闻界和公共生活中的种族主义；人工智能泡沫和下一次金融危机；哈里和梅根目前在美国有多少间浴室，以及英国是否存在拥有如此数量厕所硬件的房产。也许可以预见的是，尽管哈利和梅根的回归确实出现了，但观众的问题并没有整齐地分布在整套时事中——更多的是关于气候危机的哪个问题最能代表每个人都想谈论气候危机的事实。刚刚传来厄尔尼诺现象将给我们带来前所未有的潮湿秋季的消息，但这不太可能缓解创纪录的炎热干燥夏季的干涸大地。庄稼歉收，土地着火，没有人注意到。继续阅读...

body.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and benzodiazepines. Some effects were still detectable years later, suggesting past medication use may strongly influence the gut bacteria people carry today.
body.zh: 常见药物可能会在服用最后一剂药物后很长时间内重塑肠道微生物群。在一项对 2,500 多人进行的研究中，研究人员发现持久的微生物变化不仅与抗生素有关，还与抗抑郁药、β-受体阻滞剂、降酸药和苯二氮卓类药物有关。几年后仍然可以检测到一些影响，这表明过去的药物使用可能会强烈影响人们今天携带的肠道细菌。

title.en: Bird flu is spreading. Your backyard feeder could make it worse
title.zh: 禽流感正在蔓延。你的后院喂食器可能会让情况变得更糟

summary.en: Backyard bird feeders could become unexpected hotspots for H5N1 as Australia’s bird flu outbreak spreads, bringing species together in ways that rarely occur naturally. Experts say stopping feeding is safest, while smaller amounts of food, no hand-feeding, and careful cleaning...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Backyard bird feeding is one of our country’s most popular pastimes. Research reveals about half of Australian households feed wild birds, with many people doing so daily.

However, this practice could act as a superspreader event – where a disease infects an unusually high number of people or animals – of the H5N1 virus. This deadly strain of bird flu has already decimated wild bird and mammal populations worldwide. It is now spreading across Australia, most recently killing more than 1,000 crested terns and a long-nosed fur seal, the first detection in a mainland mammal.

Although many Australians feed wild birds, the practice is controversial . This is mainly due to concerns about people offering unsuitable foods and birds becoming dependent on humans.

So why is backyard bird feeding such a problem when it comes to bird flu? And can we do it safely?

People feed wild birds for various reasons , including to provide food during tough times or simply enjoy their presence. Most care deeply about their avian companions and believe feeding them is helpful .

Feeding wild birds heightens the risk of disease transmission at feeding locations . When we offer supplementary food, such as seeds or meat scraps, this attracts birds of many different species in a combination and number that would not happen in nature. They may carry deadly diseases, such as the H5N1 virus, and potentially spread them to other birds.

This can create a transmission hotspot right on our back deck. And catching bird flu can push our most threatened species, such as the orange-bellied parrot , to the brink of extinction.

The fatal effects of H5N1 are not only contained to birds. Scavenger animals such as possums, red foxes and crows can be exposed to the virus while devouring the carcasses of infected birds. Humans in close contact with infected wildlife, such as wildlife carers and veterinarians, can contract H5N1. However, human infection is rare and typically only causes mild symptoms.

Backyard bird feeding may seem like a harmless hobby. But given how many people do it, and the risks it poses to both birds and people, bird feeding activities could lead to many more wildlife deaths .

The most effective strategy is to stop feeding birds altogether. If you don’t offer food to wild birds, they will be less likely to congregate in your backyard or garden. And they will be fine without your help. Our previous research found most birds that visit feeders obtain most of their nutrition from natural sources, such as insects and worms. So the food we provide is a snack, not an essential meal.

Having feeders full of seeds and leftover meat will attract more birds. So to discourage them from congregating, simply provide less food. Much like COVID-era social...
body.zh: 后院喂鸟是我国最受欢迎的消遣之一。研究显示，大约一半的澳大利亚家庭喂养野生鸟类，其中许多人每天都这样做。 然而，这种做法可能会成为 H5N1 病毒的超级传播事件——一种疾病感染异常多的人或动物。这种致命的禽流感病毒已经导致世界各地的野生鸟类和哺乳动物数量大量减少。它目前正在澳大利亚各地蔓延，最近导致 1,000 多只凤头燕鸥和一只长鼻海豹死亡，这是首次在大陆哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 尽管许多澳大利亚人喂养野生鸟类，但这种做法存在争议。这主要是由于担心人们提供不合适的食物以及鸟类变得依赖人类。 那么，为什么在禽流感方面，后院喂鸟会成为一个问题呢？我们可以安全地做到这一点吗？ 人们出于各种原因喂养野生鸟类，包括在困难时期提供食物或只是享受它们的存在。大多数人非常关心他们的鸟类同伴，并相信喂养它们是有帮助的。 喂养野鸟会增加喂养地点疾病传播的风险。当我们提供补充食物（例如种子或肉末）时，会吸引许多不同物种的鸟类，其组合和数量在自然界中是不会发生的。它们可能携带致命疾病，例如 H5N1 病毒，并有可能将其传播给其他鸟类。 这可以在我们的后甲板上创建一个传输热点。感染禽流感可能会将橙腹鹦鹉等最受威胁的物种推向灭绝的边缘。 H5N1 的致命影响不仅限于鸟类。负鼠、红狐和乌鸦等食腐动物在吞食受感染鸟类的尸体时可能会接触到病毒。与受感染野生动物密切接触的人类，例如野生动物护理人员和兽医，可能会感染 H5N1。然而，人类感染很少见，通常只会引起轻微症状。 后院喂鸟似乎是一种无害的爱好。但考虑到有多少人这样做，以及它对鸟类和人类造成的风险，鸟类喂养活动可能会导致更多野生动物死亡。 最有效的策略是完全停止喂养鸟类。如果您不向野鸟提供食物，它们就不太可能聚集在您的后院或花园里。没有你的帮助，他们也会没事的。我们之前的研究发现，大多数访问喂食器的鸟类从昆虫和蠕虫等天然来源获取大部分营养。所以我们提供的食物是零食，而不是必需的膳食。 装满种子和剩余肉的喂食器会吸引更多的鸟类。因此，为了阻止他们聚集，只需提供更少的食物即可。就像新冠病毒时代的社交......

title.en: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
title.zh: 一条幽灵般的星带揭示了隐藏的暗物质

summary.en: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. Because the stars trace the galaxy’s gravity, researchers used the stream to estimate how much invisible dark matter surrounds it and how...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For billions of years, an ancient cluster of stars has been gradually coming apart, shedding stars that now form a faint, narrow ribbon across space. That delicate structure is offering astronomers a new way to investigate one of the universe's biggest mysteries.

An international research team, including an astrophysicist from Northwestern University, has identified the first stellar stream of this type ever observed outside the Milky Way. Astronomers have long predicted that such streams should exist around other galaxies, but their extreme faintness has made them difficult to detect.

The newly discovered stream also offers scientists an unusual tool for studying dark matter, which remains one of the major unanswered questions in astrophysics. By analyzing the stream's shape, researchers reconstructed the gravitational field of its host galaxy and used that information to determine how unseen dark matter influenced the stars' paths.

The findings could eventually help scientists investigate how dark matter is distributed across many different galaxies and throughout the universe.

"The stars in a stellar stream all travel along nearly the same orbit, and that orbit is shaped by the galaxy's gravity," said Northwestern's Tjitske Starkenburg, who coauthored the study. "By modeling that gravity, we can estimate the galaxy's total mass. We already know roughly how much of that mass comes from visible matter like stars, so the rest must be dark matter."

Starkenburg, an expert in extragalactic astronomy, is a research assistant professor at Northwestern's Center for Interdisciplinary Exploration and Research in Astrophysics. The study was co-led by Julie Kiel Holm of the University of Copenhagen and Sarah Pearson of the Technical University of Denmark.

Globular clusters are densely packed groups of stars held together by gravity. As one of these clusters travels around its host galaxy, the galaxy's gravitational pull can slowly strip stars away from it.

Those stars do not simply scatter in every direction. Instead, they tend to continue along nearly the same orbital path, creating long, thin stellar streams that retain information about the gravitational forces they have experienced.

Astronomers have identified dozens of streams produced by globular clusters inside the Milky Way. Until now, however, no comparable stream had been detected in another galaxy. Such structures are generally so faint that they disappear against the light of their host galaxies.

The breakthrough came through archival observations from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope presented by study coauthors David Sand and Catherine Fielder, both astronomers at the University of Arizona. While study coauthor David Hendel was examining images of the ultra-diffuse galaxy UGC 9050-Dw1 for...
body.zh: 数十亿年来，古老的星团逐渐分裂，脱落的恒星现在在太空中形成一条微弱而狭窄的丝带。这种微妙的结构为天文学家提供了一种研究宇宙最大谜团之一的新方法。 包括西北大学天体物理学家在内的一个国际研究小组发现了在银河系外首次观测到的此类恒星流。天文学家长期以来一直预测，此类流应该存在于其他星系周围，但它们的极度微弱使它们难以被发现。 新发现的暗物质流还为科学家提供了一种不寻常的工具来研究暗物质，暗物质仍然是天体物理学中尚未解答的主要问题之一。通过分析该流的形状，研究人员重建了其宿主星系的引力场，并利用该信息来确定看不见的暗物质如何影响恒星的路径。 这些发现最终可以帮助科学家研究暗物质如何分布在许多不同的星系和整个宇宙中。 “恒星流中的恒星都沿着几乎相同的轨道运行，而该轨道是由星系的引力决定的，”西北大学的蒂斯克·斯塔肯堡（Tjitske Starkenburg）说，他是这项研究的合著者。 “通过对引力进行建模，我们可以估计星系的总质量。我们已经大致知道其中有多少质量来自恒星等可见物质，所以其余的一定是暗物质。” 斯塔肯伯格是河外天文学专家，西北大学天体物理学跨学科探索与研究中心的研究助理教授。这项研究由哥本哈根大学的 Julie Kiel Holm 和丹麦技术大学的 Sarah Pearson 共同领导。 球状星团是由重力聚集在一起的密集恒星群。当这些星团之一围绕其宿主星系运行时，星系的引力会慢慢地将恒星从它身上剥离。 这些星星并不简单地分散在各个方向。相反，它们倾向于继续沿着几乎相同的轨道路径运行，产生又长又细的恒星流，保留有关它们所经历的引力的信息。 天文学家已经发现了银河系内部球状星团产生的数十条流。然而，到目前为止，尚未在另一个星系中检测到类似的流。这些结构通常非常微弱，以至于它们在宿主星系的光线下消失了。 这一突破来自美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的档案观测，该观测由研究合著者、亚利桑那大学的天文学家大卫·桑德和凯瑟琳·菲尔德提出。当研究合著者 David Hendel 正在检查超漫射星系 UGC 9050-Dw1 的图像时……

title.en: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster
title.zh: 睡眠过多或过少都可能使身体衰老得更快

summary.en: Both too little and too much sleep may be linked to faster aging throughout the body. Researchers analyzing 23 biological aging clocks found the lowest aging levels among people sleeping about 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day. Short or long sleep was also associated with numerous...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A new analysis of biological aging across the human body suggests that both sleeping too little and sleeping too much are associated with faster aging in the brain, heart, lungs, immune system, and other organs. These sleep patterns were also linked to a broad range of diseases.

"Previous studies have found that sleep is largely linked to aging and the pathological burden of the brain. Our study goes further and shows that too little and too much sleep are associated with faster aging in nearly every organ, supporting the idea that sleep is important in maintaining organ health within a coordinated brain-body network, including metabolic balance and a healthy immune system," says study leader Junhao Wen, assistant professor of radiology at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.

Scientists are increasingly using aging clocks to estimate whether a person is aging biologically faster or slower than their chronological age. These tools rely on machine learning and biological information (e.g., proteins from a minimally invasive blood test) to calculate patterns associated with aging.

Many aging clocks provide a single measure for the entire body. However, different organs can age at different speeds. One familiar example is the decline in ovarian function that contributes to the biological clock associated with female fertility.

Wen and his colleagues have been developing aging clocks that focus on individual organs. The goal is to provide more detailed and potentially more personalized information about a person's health.

"Everyone is excited by these aging clocks and their ability to predict disease and mortality risk," Wen says. "But to me, the more exciting question is, can we link aging clocks to a lifestyle factor that can be modified in time to slow aging?"

Sleep offered researchers an ideal way to explore that question because mounting evidence suggests that sleep plays an important role in health. Wen also had a personal interest in the issue.

"I'm also a light sleeper and was getting worried about the effects on myself," says Wen.

To create the aging clocks, Wen used information from about half a million participants in the UK Biobank. Machine learning was applied to identify biological signatures associated with aging in different organs.

The researchers built clocks using several types of information, including structural measurements from medical imaging, proteins associated with specific organs, and molecules detected in the blood.

"In the liver, for example, we have an aging clock built with protein data, an aging clock of metabolic data, and an aging clock of imaging data," Wen says. "This allows us to see whether sleep is distinctively associated with aging clocks derived from multiple omics and...
body.zh: 一项对人体生物衰老的新分析表明，睡眠过少和睡眠过多都与大脑、心脏、肺、免疫系统和其他器官的加速衰老有关。这些睡眠模式也与多种疾病有关。 “之前的研究发现，睡眠在很大程度上与衰老和大脑的病理负担有关。我们的研究更进一步，表明睡眠太少和太多都与几乎每个器官的衰老速度加快有关，这支持了这样的观点，即睡眠对于维持协调的脑体网络中的器官健康非常重要，包括代谢平衡和健康的免疫系统，”研究负责人、哥伦比亚大学瓦格洛斯内外科医学院放射学助理教授文俊豪说。 科学家越来越多地使用衰老时钟来估计一个人的生物学衰老速度是否比实际年龄快或慢。这些工具依靠机器学习和生物信息（例如，微创血液测试中的蛋白质）来计算与衰老相关的模式。 许多老化时钟为整个身体提供单一测量。然而，不同的器官会以不同的速度老化。一个熟悉的例子是卵巢功能下降，这会影响与女性生育能力相关的生物钟。 温和他的同事们一直在开发关注个体器官的衰老时钟。目标是提供有关个人健康的更详细且可能更个性化的信息。 “每个人都对这些衰老时钟及其预测疾病和死亡风险的能力感到兴奋，”文说。 “但对我来说，更令人兴奋的问题是，我们能否将衰老时钟与可以及时改变以减缓衰老的生活方式因素联系起来？” 睡眠为研究人员提供了探索这个问题的理想方法，因为越来越多的证据表明睡眠在健康中发挥着重要作用。温家宝对这个问题也有个人兴趣。 “我的睡眠质量也很浅，我很担心这对自己造成的影响，”文说。 为了创建衰老时钟，温使用了英国生物银行约 50 万参与者的信息。应用机器学习来识别与不同器官衰老相关的生物特征。 研究人员利用多种类型的信息构建了时钟，包括医学成像的结构测量、与特定器官相关的蛋白质以及血液中检测到的分子。 “例如，在肝脏中，我们有一个由蛋白质数据构建的衰老时钟、一个代谢数据的衰老时钟和一个成像数据的衰老时钟，”文说。 “这使我们能够了解睡眠是否与来自多个组学的衰老时钟有明显的相关性，并且......

title.en: UK's rarest bird of prey rears new chicks in secret location
title.zh: 英国最稀有的猛禽在秘密地点抚养新雏鸟

summary.en: The Montagu Harrier successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The UK's rarest bird of prey has successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location, the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) has reported.

A male Montagu's harrier, known as "AU" by conservationists, bred with two different females, rearing six chicks across two nests on English farmland.

Montagu's harriers were put on a "red list" of birds most at risk in the UK in 2021. Numbers have declined from a high of nine successful nests in 2011, to no evidence of successful breeding between 2020 and 2024.

An RSPB spokesperson said: "We are doing our absolute utmost to save this iconic species in the UK and are delighted with six flying juveniles this year."

The charity said careful monitoring, in partnership with the farmers on whose land the birds nested, meant the nests were protected by fences to exclude ground predators such as foxes.

The single male Montagu's harrier has also been working very hard to keep his two nests of hungry chicks fed.

The BBC was given exclusive access to the nest and was able to witness some of the spectacular feeding behaviour of the raptors: the male drops prey in mid-air and the female rolls upside down to catch it in her talons.

These slender, long-winged raptors make an epic annual migration to Africa in winter and return to Europe to nest over summer, often setting up home in agricultural fields.

But little is known about the behaviour of juvenile harriers once they leave the nest. This year, for the first time, the RSPB has fitted two of the chicks with satellite tags in the hope of providing the birds with better protection.

"It will allow us for the first time ever to work out where they're going, what migration route, how long they'll spend there, and will they come back to the UK in the first year or the second year," said Mark Thomas, head of investigations at the RSPB.

It is also hoped the tagging can better protect the rare birds from having their nests, on the ground, hidden among crops, inadvertently destroyed.

"This is a species right on the brink, and climate change is not helping that. The harvest here, for example, this year, was like a month earlier than in previous years. So it almost puts any Montagu's harrier nest at the peril of inadvertently being destroyed by farm machinery," said Thomas.

Conservationists have urged birders to look out for the youngsters, and report any sightings by emailing the RSPB's Montagu's hotline at montys@rspb.org.uk.
body.zh: 据英国皇家鸟类保护协会 (RSPB) 报道，英国最稀有的猛禽已连续第二年在同一秘密地点成功筑巢。 一只雄性蒙塔古鹞被自然资源保护者称为“AU”，与两只不同的雌性一起繁殖，在英国农田的两个巢中养育了六只雏鸟。 2021 年，蒙塔古鹞被列入英国最危险鸟类的“红色名单”。数量已从 2011 年成功筑巢 9 个的高峰下降到 2020 年至 2024 年间没有成功繁殖的证据。 皇家鸟类保护协会的一位发言人表示：“我们正在尽最大努力拯救英国的这一标志性物种，我们对今年有六只飞行幼崽感到高兴。” 该慈善机构表示，与鸟儿筑巢的土地上的农民合作进行仔细监控，意味着鸟巢受到栅栏的保护，以排除狐狸等地面掠食者。 单身雄性蒙塔古鹞也一直在非常努力地工作，以保证他的两窝饥饿的雏鸟有吃的。 英国广播公司获得了进入猛禽巢穴的独家访问权限，并目睹了猛禽的一些壮观的进食行为：雄性猛禽将猎物抛在半空中，雌性则翻滚着用爪子捕捉猎物。 这些细长、长翼的猛禽每年冬天都会进行一次史诗般的迁徙，前往非洲，并在夏天返回欧洲筑巢，通常在农田里安家。 但人们对幼年鹞离开巢穴后的行为知之甚少。今年，皇家鸟类保护协会首次为其中两只小鸟安装了卫星标签，希望为这些小鸟提供更好的保护。 英国皇家鸟类保护协会调查负责人马克·托马斯表示：“这将使我们有史以来第一次弄清楚他们要去哪里、迁徙路线是什么、他们将在那里待多久，以及他们会在第一年还是第二年回到英国。” 人们还希望标签能够更好地保护这些稀有鸟类的巢穴，它们在地面上、隐藏在农作物中的巢穴不会被无意中破坏。 “这是一个濒临灭绝的物种，气候变化对此无济于事。例如，今年这里的收成比往年早了一个月。因此，这几乎使任何蒙塔古鹞巢都面临着被农业机械无意中摧毁的危险，”托马斯说。 环保人士敦促观鸟者留意这些幼鸟，并通过电子邮件报告皇家鸟类保护协会蒙塔古热线：montys@rspb.org.uk。

body.en: 27 August 1926 : Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the common creatures which we, boastfully, think we understand. Who would imagine that a wasp could ascend so high! It has proved that it can, but what did it go up for? A certain town-tip that I pass occasionally is a great place for wasps; they swarm over the rags, paper, tins, and rubbish of all kinds, and undoubtedly find much that for their grubs is fattening food in what man has thrown away as useless. Probably the old meat and fruit tins, jam pots too, are mines of treasure for these busy wasps. But surely no wasp expects to find a town-tip up in the sky, nor can it be worth the labour of ascent to that altitude in the hope of finding winged game, though the wasp is an excellent fly-catcher. The mother or queen wasps are busy laying eggs, so that cannot have tempted a drone to seek a mate in the upper air. Nuptial flight may explain the swarm of green flies at a great height; many insects ascend when they are stirred by amorous impulse, and high flight must influence distribution. A strong wind would carry them far from their original home, and doubtless many insect hordes are swept out to sea and trouble us no more. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1926 年 8 月 27 日：飞行员报告称在几乎一英里高的天空中看到了黄蜂和小绿蝇。经验丰富的飞行员报告称在 6,000 英尺高空发现了黄蜂，在 4,000 英尺高处发现了小绿蝇（可能是蚜虫），这应该让我们意识到，我们对这些我们自以为了解的常见生物的习性知之甚少。谁能想到黄蜂能飞得这么高！事实证明可以，但是它涨起来是为了什么？我偶尔经过的某个城镇尖端是黄蜂的好地方。它们成群结队地爬过破布、纸张、罐头盒和各种垃圾，毫无疑问，它们在人类丢弃的无用物品中发现了许多让它们的幼虫增肥的食物。对于这些忙碌的黄蜂来说，旧的肉类和水果罐头、果酱罐可能都是宝藏。但毫无疑问，没有黄蜂期望在天空中找到城镇的顶端，也不值得为了寻找有翅膀的猎物而费力爬到那个高度，尽管黄蜂是出色的捕蝇者。黄蜂妈妈或蜂王正忙于产卵，因此不可能诱使雄蜂在高空寻找配偶。婚飞或许可以解释为什么绿蝇会飞到很高的地方。许多昆虫在受到爱情冲动的刺激时就会上升，高飞必然会影响分布。一阵强风会将它们吹离原来的家园，毫无疑问，许多昆虫群会被卷入大海，不再打扰我们。继续阅读...

title.en: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
title.zh: 法国将溺水人数急剧上升与热浪联系起来

summary.en: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
France has seen 301 drownings since 19 June, a government minister has said, linking the sharp rise in deaths from last year to a series of prolonged heatwaves.

Sports and Youth Minister Marina Ferrari told France Inter radio the number of deaths - a 14% hike on 2025 - was a "tragic toll".

France, Spain and Italy have all been hit by heatwaves that have triggered massive wildfires that have scorched thousands of hectares of land this summer.

Ferrari said people had been taking risks by going into the water, adding: "Many deadly accidents have occurred in areas that are not authorised or supervised for swimming."

She said a number of the drownings were recorded in "open water, in canals for example".

Ferrari said the government was working with regional authorities "to improve swimming areas and make things safer".

Speaking on Friday, she added that "many drownings, particularly among the elderly, occurred in individual pools".

The minister said that sudden immersion in cold water on a hot day could cause shock, and that in some cases "people can also exceed their physical capabilities".

In June, Ferrari warned that too many people were trying to cool off in rivers and canals without necessarily taking the risks into account.

Climate change is driving up global average temperatures, making heatwaves more frequent and intense.

This has been felt acutely in Europe, which is the fastest warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service. , external

A heatwave in June saw a nuclear power plant in south-west France temporarily shut down because water temperatures in the River Garonne topped 28C. Under French laws, water used to cool the reactors at the Golfech plant must not exceed that temperature.

Some monuments like the Eiffel Tower also decided to close early because of the high temperatures in Paris during the heatwave.

The dry conditions also saw wildfires spread across France, with Gironde, around the city of Bordeaux in the south-west of the country, being the worse affected area, with more than 200,000 people being forced from their homes in late July.

France has logged 7,300 excess deaths between late May and 22 July, according to provisional figures from the public health authorities.
body.zh: 一位政府部长表示，自 6 月 19 日以来，法国已发生 301 起溺水事件，将去年死亡人数急剧上升与一系列长期热浪联系起来。 体育和青年部长玛丽娜·法拉利 (Marina Ferrari) 告诉法国国际米兰电台，死亡人数比 2025 年增加 14%，这是一个“悲惨的数字”。 今年夏天，法国、西班牙和意大利都遭受了热浪袭击，引发了大规模野火，烧毁了数千公顷土地。 法拉利表示，人们一直冒险下水，并补充道：“许多致命事故发生在未经授权或监督的游泳区域。” 她说，许多溺水事件是在“开放水域，例如运河”中发生的。 法拉利表示，政府正在与地方当局合作“改善游泳区并使事情变得更安全”。 她在周五发表讲话时补充说，“许多溺水事件，特别是老年人溺水事件，都发生在个别泳池中”。 这位部长表示，在炎热的天气里突然浸入冷水中可能会导致休克，并且在某些情况下“人们也会超出其身体承受能力”。 六月，法拉利警告说，太多人试图在河流和运河中降温，而没有考虑到风险。 气候变化正在推高全球平均气温，使热浪更加频繁和强烈。 根据哥白尼气候服务机构的数据，欧洲对此有着强烈的感受，欧洲是变暖最快的大陆，升温速度是全球平均水平的两倍。 , 外部 6月的热浪导致法国西南部的一座核电站暂时关闭，因为加龙河水温高达28摄氏度。根据法国法律，用于冷却戈尔菲什核电站反应堆的水不得超过该温度。 由于热浪期间巴黎气温较高，埃菲尔铁塔等一些古迹也决定提前关闭。 干燥的气候还导致野火蔓延到法国各地，其中该国西南部波尔多市周围的吉伦特省是受灾最严重的地区，7月下旬已有超过20万人被迫离开家园。 根据公共卫生当局的临时数据，5月下旬至7月22日期间，法国已有7,300人超额死亡。

title.en: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
title.zh: 总理表示，分享危险驾驶视频“确实应受到谴责”

summary.en: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The government has urged social media companies to remove posts celebrating dangerous driving, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham branded sharing them "truly reprehensible".

Earlier Defence Minister Luke Pollard told BBC Breakfast that "social media companies could take the content down easily and adjust their algorithms to stop it being distributed".

Two police officers died when a car going the wrong way down a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle near Middlesbrough on Saturday. Five passengers in the other car were also killed.

A TikTok account believed to belong to one of the five passengers, 18-year-old Makai Saddington, previously shared videos appearing to show dangerous driving, which have since been removed.

But Cleveland Police said "there is no evidence to indicate that filming of the activities that took place on Friday night and Saturday morning has taken place for the purposes of TikTok".

Pollard said the government had "already taken steps" to tell social media companies to take down such content.

He added: "They know exactly what content is on their site, they know how their algorithm works.

"They also know that people post content to get views and the more views you get, sometimes you get money for it, so it's a financial incentive to post outrageous content that gets more people watching it."

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Burnham said the people who share footage glorifying dangerous driving are "doing something that's truly reprehensible".

A Downing Street spokeswoman said "the glorification of dangerous driving for clips and entertainment is utterly disgraceful".

She added that the culture secretary has been clear that footage should be removed by social media platforms "in line with their legal obligations", and that Ofcom has the government's "full backing to take action" against those that fail in their duties.

Video content featuring illegal activity is not necessarily illegal itself - according to the Online Safety Act - it is up to the social network to decide whether flagged content is illegal and act accordingly.

TikTok said its policies prohibit content that could cause significant physical harm, including dangerous driving.

It added that it is actively removing videos and accounts that break its rules, including the account believed to belong to Saddington.

The company said between January and March 2026, 99.8% of the content removed for violating those policies it took down proactively.

While TikTok is taking some videos down, it is not necessarily because it has deemed them to be illegal - it may only be because they breach the firm's own terms and conditions.

There are specific exceptions which are set out in the Online Safety Act, but they can be difficult to interpret.
