title.en: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
title.zh: Twitch 和亚马逊因使用直播训练人工智能而面临法律诉讼

summary.en: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit , external over its move to train its AI models on videos people broadcast on the popular streaming platform Twitch.

The move faced backlash from users when it was announced in August - with people having the option to opt-out if they do not want their data used this way.

The class action lawsuit has been brought on behalf of millions of streamers who use Twitch, alleging its parent company Amazon used their videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.

Streamers on the platform reportedly produced , external more than 215 million hours of content in the first few months of 2026 alone.

It claims Twitch breached its contract with users by using that content as AI training data for Amazon's models without obtaining their permission.

It adds streamers should not have their work commercially exploited to develop AI without consent or compensation.

The lawsuit seeks damages for streamers whose content was allegedly used to train AI, as well as an order preventing Amazon from continuing the alleged practice.

It is not clear when Amazon began collecting Twitch users' data to train its AI models.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton previously said he did not know if users' data had been scraped for training before it gave people the opportunity to opt-out.

He said he was unsure what Amazon "has done in terms of model training and what they've used and not used".

In Twitch's own FAQs about AI training, it said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text".

It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Those that want to disable the feature would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

However, the opt-out only applies to individual streams, meaning creators' content could still be used for AI training when they appear in a stream where the feature remains enabled.

Amazon, which bought Twitch for nearly $1bn (£740m) in 2014, has made AI a major focus as it competes with Google, Meta and other tech giants.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 亚马逊因在流行的流媒体平台 Twitch 上播放的视频来训练其人工智能模型而面临外部诉讼。 此举在 8 月份宣布时遭到了用户的强烈反对，如果人们不希望自己的数据以这种方式使用，他们可以选择退出。 该集体诉讼是代表数百万使用 Twitch 的主播提起的，指控其母公司亚马逊在未经许可或适当补偿的情况下使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。 据报道，仅 2026 年前几个月，该平台上的流媒体就制作了超过 2.15 亿小时的内容。 它声称 Twitch 在未经用户许可的情况下将这些内容用作亚马逊模型的人工智能训练数据，违反了与用户的合同。 它还补充说，未经同意或补偿，主播不应将其作品用于商业用途以开发人工智能。 该诉讼要求对内容据称被用来训练人工智能的流媒体造成损害，并要求下令阻止亚马逊继续其所谓的做法。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊何时开始收集 Twitch 用户数据来训练其人工智能模型。 Twitch 的首席产品官迈克·明顿 (Mike Minton) 此前表示，他不知道用户的数据是否已被抓取用于培训，然后才给人们选择退出的机会。 他表示，他不确定亚马逊“在模型训练方面做了什么，以及他们使用了什么和没有使用什么”。 在 Twitch 自己的关于人工智能训练的常见问题解答中，它表示一个人的音频可能会被用来“完善创建语音到文本的模型”。 该公司表示，这将有助于改进 Twitch 流媒体和亚马逊视频的自动字幕。 想要禁用该功能的用户需要导航到 Streamer 仪表板中的“设置”选项卡，单击“安全和隐私”选项卡，然后向下滚动到选项底部附近并关闭“生成 AI 训练”。 然而，选择退出仅适用于单个流，这意味着当创作者的内容出现在该功能保持启用的流中时，仍然可以用于人工智能训练。 亚马逊于 2014 年以近 10 亿美元（7.4 亿英镑）的价格收购了 Twitch，在与谷歌、Meta 和其他科技巨头竞争时，已将人工智能作为主要焦点。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

title.en: ‘A cognitive cacophony’: hands-on with the Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 beta test
title.zh: “认知杂音”：《使命召唤：现代战争 4》Beta 测试实践

summary.en: Players will get what they expect from the new CoD title: boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. But what’s with all the distractions? There’s a lot riding on this year’s Call of Duty, the inescapable first-person shootfest that’s been lobbing a grenade...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Players will get what they expect from the new CoD title: boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. But what’s with all the distractions? There’s a lot riding on this year’s Call of Duty, the inescapable first-person shootfest that’s been lobbing a grenade into the autumn release schedule since 2003. Previous instalment, Black Ops 7, performed poorly compared to previous titles, forcing Activision to post a semi-apology to fans. And that’s not the only challenge Modern Warfare 4 is facing: there’s a new indie shooter, Wardogs, promising a feel somewhere between classic CoD and Classic Battlefield. Then, lurking on the horizon, in mirror shades and an exotic sports car, is Grand Theft Auto 6, which is surely going to smash and grab all the attention (and money) from the market in mid-November. The good news is that, judging by the early access beta test that ran over the penultimate August weekend, we’re definitely getting what we expect from a Modern Warfare title: quasi-authentic boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. The weapons and general gunplay are highly effective, from default assault rifle, the Han 86 – a classic CoD beginner’s gun with decent fire rate and handling – to the bullet-spraying Nightshade SMG and the absolutely lethal KG-7 Vulcan sniper rifle. They all feel good to hold and fire, and there’s enough balance to let you experiment with slightly more offbeat numbers like the burst-fire Hyeon AR and the possibly overpowered Mar-9 marksman rifle. body.zh: 玩家将从新的 CoD 游戏中获得他们所期望的东西：具有轻微战术优势的实地军事行动。但所有的干扰是怎么回事呢？今年的《使命召唤》有很多亮点，这是一场不可避免的第一人称射击盛宴，自 2003 年以来，它一直在秋季发布时间表中投掷手榴弹。上一期《黑色行动 7》与之前的游戏相比表现不佳，迫使动视公司向粉丝们发表了半道歉的声明。这并不是《现代战争 4》面临的唯一挑战：还有一款新的独立射击游戏《Wardogs》，它给人的感觉介于经典 CoD 和经典战地之间。然后，潜伏在地平线上的《侠盗猎车手 6》（Grand Theft Auto 6），戴着镜罩和一辆异国情调的跑车，它肯定会在 11 月中旬粉碎并吸引市场的所有注意力（和金钱）。好消息是，从八月倒数第二个周末进行的早期测试来看，我们肯定得到了我们对《现代战争》游戏的期望：准真实的实地军事行动，具有轻微的战术优势。武器和一般枪战都非常有效，从默认的突击步枪 Han 86（一款经典的 CoD 初学者枪，具有不错的射速和操控性）到子弹喷射的 Nightshade SMG 和绝对致命的 KG-7 Vulcan 狙击步枪。它们握持和开火的感觉都很好，而且有足够的平衡性让你可以尝试稍微另类的数字，比如连发的 Hyeon AR 和可能被压倒的 Mar-9 射手步枪。继续阅读...

title.en: Review: Chuwi's $449 Unibook laptop is a funhouse-mirror MacBook Neo
title.zh: 评测：Chuwi 售价 449 美元的 Unibook 笔记本电脑是一款有趣的镜子 MacBook Neo

summary.en: The Unibook is a weird entry-level laptop for people with patience.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: In another time, the MacBook Neo could have caused a substantial realignment of the lowish-end laptop business. Sure, it has shortcomings compared to the MacBook Air, but it could have at least encouraged PC makers to start shipping consistently decent keyboards, screens, and build quality in the Neo's $599 price window. The PC makers did start responding, thanks in part to Intel's actually new non-Ultra Core Series 3 processors (codenamed Wildcat Lake). Intel has resisted its usual compunction to serve the budget market with aging, re-labeled silicon and has created a lower-end, lower-performance processor with the same building blocks (and the same manufacturing processes) as this year's high-end, high-performance models. The likes of Dell, Acer, Asus, and Lenovo began hopping on the Wildcat Lake train fairly quickly, announcing would-be Neo competitors. But it felt like most of them were having trouble matching the Neo's barebones specs, let alone undercutting them. Dell's XPS 13 started at $599, but only for students. It would be $699 for everyone else . Acer's Swift Air 14 was announced at $699 , too. Sure, sometimes these offered features the Neo didn't have. But the point of the Neo is that it eschews frills and frippery in favor of nailing the basics. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在另一个时期，MacBook Neo 可能会导致低端笔记本电脑业务发生重大调整。当然，与 MacBook Air 相比，它有缺点，但它至少可以鼓励 PC 制造商开始在 Neo 599 美元的价格范围内提供一贯不错的键盘、屏幕和制造质量。 PC 制造商确实开始做出反应，这在一定程度上要归功于英特尔实际上新的非超酷睿系列 3 处理器（代号为 Wildcat Lake）。英特尔没有像往常一样，用老化、重新贴标签的芯片来服务预算市场，并创造了一款低端、低性能处理器，其构建模块（和制造工艺）与今年的高端、高性能型号相同。戴尔、宏碁、华硕和联想等公司很快就开始搭上 Wildcat Lake 列车，宣布潜在的 Neo 竞争对手。但感觉他们中的大多数人都难以匹配 Neo 的准系统规格，更不用说削弱它们了。戴尔 XPS 13 起售价为 599 美元，但仅限学生。其他人的价格是 699 美元。宏碁的 Swift Air 14 也宣布售价 699 美元。当然，有时这些提供了 Neo 所没有的功能。但 Neo 的要点在于，它避免了多余的装饰和花哨的东西，而是注重基本的设计。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Due to need for "absolute success," China delays critical Moon launch to 2027
title.zh: 由于需要“绝对成功”，中国将关键的月球发射推迟到2027年

summary.en: "The Chang’e 7 mission does not meet the conditions for launch."
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China's "Manned Space" program issued a terse announcement on Sunday regarding its much-anticipated Chang’e 7 lunar exploration mission. The agency stated: "In keeping with the principle of proceeding prudently and reliably, and ensuring absolute success, after a comprehensive assessment it has been determined that the Chang’e 7 mission does not meet the conditions for launch and therefore cannot be carried out during the planned launch window this year." The Chinese message offered no explanation for the cause of the delay from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, located on an island in the South China Sea. Consisting of a lunar orbiter, lander, rover, and a mini-hopper of a probe, the mission was due to launch as early as Sunday on a Long March 5 rocket. It is intended to land at the South Pole of the Moon. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 中国的“载人航天”计划周日就其备受期待的嫦娥七号探月任务发布了一份简短的公告。该机构表示：“本着审慎可靠、确保绝对成功的原则，经综合评估，确定嫦娥七号任务不符合发射条件，无法在今年计划的发射窗口内进行。”中国的消息没有解释位于南海岛屿上的文昌航天发射场发射延误的原因。该任务由月球轨道飞行器、着陆器、月球车和探测器的小型漏斗组成，最早将于周日由长征五号火箭发射。它的目的是在月球南极着陆。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Volcanoes that made history
title.zh: 创造历史的火山

summary.en: Enormous eruptions altered Earth’s climate and societies all over the globe.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The first telegram arrived in Singapore on a Monday, sent from the city of Batavia in the Dutch East Indies (now Jakarta, Indonesia). “Terrific detonations from Krakatau (volcanic island),” it reported. Soon afterward: “Stones falling. Village near Anjer washed away.” The wires continued clattering out news of bridges destroyed, boats smashed, lighthouses “disappeared.” By noon on Tuesday, the scope of the natural disaster was clear: “Where once Mount Krakatau stood the sea now plays.” Within days, the source of the destruction was known worldwide. On the morning of August 27, 1883, a volcanic eruption had obliterated two islands in the strait between Java and Sumatra, and most of a third. More than 36,000 people perished, the majority in devastating tsunamis that raced outward from the colossal explosion. Thanks to Victorian-era telecommunications, it was the first time in history that people around the globe could begin to document, in near real time, the immediate and long-term effects of a catastrophic volcanic eruption. What they learned over the next few years laid the foundations for the modern science of volcanology. And it was an especially eye-opening lesson in how the biggest eruptions can influence climate, agriculture, and even the course of human history. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 第一份电报于周一抵达新加坡，是从荷属东印度群岛的巴达维亚市（现印度尼西亚雅加达）发出的。报道称，“喀拉喀托（火山岛）发生了可怕的爆炸。”不久之后：“石头落下。安杰尔附近的村庄被冲走了。”电线继续发出有关桥梁被毁、船只被撞、灯塔“消失”的消息。到周二中午，自然灾害的范围已经很清楚了：“喀拉喀托山曾经矗立的地方现在变成了大海。”几天之内，破坏的根源就被全世界所知。 1883 年 8 月 27 日早晨，火山喷发摧毁了爪哇和苏门答腊之间海峡的两个岛屿，以及第三个岛屿的大部分。超过 36,000 人丧生，其中大部分死于巨大爆炸引发的毁灭性海啸。得益于维多利亚时代的电信技术，这是历史上第一次，世界各地的人们可以开始近乎实时地记录灾难性火山喷发的直接和长期影响。他们在接下来几年中学到的知识为现代火山学科学奠定了基础。这是一次特别令人大开眼界的教训，让我们了解到最大规模的火山喷发如何影响气候、农业，甚至人类历史的进程。阅读全文 评论

title.en: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
title.zh: TikTok 将向美国支付 4 亿美元，这是最大的儿童隐私和解协议之一

summary.en: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
TikTok has agreed to pay $400m (£293m) to the US to end a lawsuit alleging its platform violated children‘s privacy, marking one of the largest ever settlements over the issue.

The deal stems from a 2024 suit by the Department of Justice under former President Joe Biden alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

Doing so was against the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), a federal law enacted in 2000. It is the same law that dozens of US states are now suing Meta over .

"Children and parents are better protected today than they were when this case began," assistant Attorney General Brett Shumate said.

Other companies to have paid penalties to the US government for COPPA violations include Google's YouTube, which in 2019 paid $170m, and Epic Games, which in 2022 paid $275m.

Meta is also now facing penalties that could exceed hundreds of billions of dollars stemming from COPPA violations alleged by attorneys general of 29 US states. A jury trial in the lawsuit started this week , with the Instagram and Facebook owner accused of targeting child users and profiting from them.

While the TikTok lawsuit predates last year's split of TikTok's US business and operations from its original base of China, the settlement only involves TikTok's operations in China.

ByteDance, which is a privately held company, was most recently valued by investors at $550bn , external .

Under the terms of the deal, TikTok and ByteDance will immediately pay the DOJ $300m. It will pay another $100m when the government vacates a 2019 consent decree , external with the Federal Trade Commission.

As part of the agreement, the predecessor to ByteDance, Musical.ly, was required to pay a $5.7m fine for COPPA violations and ensure it sought parental consent for any user aged under 13.

The justice department did not detail on Friday any action against TikTok beyond the fine. But the department noted that since it sued the platform, TikTok has "undergone significant changes," including to its ownership, privacy practices and platform controls for young users.

When the lawsuit was filed, attorneys for the US said there were more than 170 million teenagers using TikTok and that the app was "directed to children." Yet, it did not effectively gauge the age of users or get parental consent for use from those underage.

In 2024, former President Biden pushed for TikTok to be either banned, or have the company divest its US operations. President Donald Trump went on to support divestment of the app, which occurred last year.

Its US operations are now 81% owned by a consortium of investors, while Bytedance maintains a 19% stake.
body.zh: TikTok 同意向美国支付 4 亿美元（2.93 亿英镑），以结束指控其平台侵犯儿童隐私的诉讼，这是该问题有史以来最大的和解协议之一。 该交易源于前总统乔·拜登领导下的司法部于 2024 年提起的诉讼，指控 TikTok 及其母公司字节跳动收集了数百万 13 岁以下用户的“大量数据”。 这样做违反了 2000 年颁布的联邦法律《儿童在线隐私保护法》(COPPA)。美国数十个州现在正在通过同一法律起诉 Meta。 助理司法部长布雷特·舒马特（Brett Shumate）表示：“与此案开始时相比，今天的儿童和家长受到了更好的保护。” 其他因违反 COPPA 行为而向美国政府支付罚款的公司包括谷歌旗下的 YouTube（2019 年支付了 1.7 亿美元）和 Epic Games（2022 年支付了 2.75 亿美元）。 美国 29 个州总检察长指控 Meta 因违反 COPPA 规定而面临可能超过数千亿美元的处罚。该诉讼的陪审团审判于本周开始，Instagram 和 Facebook 所有者被指控针对儿童用户并从中获利。 虽然 TikTok 诉讼早于去年 TikTok 的美国业务和业务从其原来的中国基地剥离出来，但和解协议仅涉及 TikTok 在中国的业务。 字节跳动是一家私营公司，最近投资者的外部估值为 5500 亿美元。 根据交易条款，TikTok 和字节跳动将立即向司法部支付 3 亿美元。当政府撤销 2019 年联邦贸易委员会的同意令时，它将再支付 1 亿美元。 作为协议的一部分，字节跳动的前身 Musical.ly 需要因违反 COPPA 规定而支付 570 万美元的罚款，并确保其为所有 13 岁以下的用户征求家长的同意。 周五，除了罚款之外，司法部没有详细说明针对 TikTok 采取的任何行动。但该部门指出，自起诉该平台以来，TikTok“经历了重大变化”，包括其所有权、隐私做法和对年轻用户的平台控制。 提起诉讼时，美国律师表示，有超过 1.7 亿青少年使用 TikTok，并且该应用程序“针对儿童”。然而，它并没有有效地衡量用户的年龄，也没有获得未成年人使用的父母同意。 2024 年，前总统拜登推动禁止 TikTok，或者让该公司剥离其美国业务。唐纳德·特朗普总统继续支持去年撤资该应用程序。 其美国业务目前由一个投资者财团持有 81% 的股份，而字节跳动则保留 19% 的股份。
